title: TD- Product Owner-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Product Owner**
**Job Summary:**
 We are seeking a Product Owner at Senior Consultant rank to drive the execution of digital products and platforms by translating business needs into clear, actionable and value\-driven product requirements. The role requires strong product ownership, backlog management, agile delivery and stakeholder collaboration skills, with the ability to connect product decisions to measurable business value, outcomes and benefits realization. The core focus of the role remains Product Management—owning the product backlog, shaping user\-centric requirements, enabling agile delivery and supporting adoption—while bringing practical exposure to value management concepts such as value cases, KPI definition, outcome tracking, prioritization by value and continuous value realization. The ideal candidate will bring experience in at least one sector or business domain, with life sciences/healthcare knowledge considered a strong advantage, and will work closely with business, engineering, data and design teams to deliver scalable digital solutions that create clear user and business impact.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring features, user stories and enhancements are clearly defined, prioritized and aligned to business value.
* Translate business needs, user feedback and domain requirements into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria and functional requirements for delivery teams.
* Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, engineering, architecture and UX teams to shape solution requirements and deliver high\-quality product increments.
* Support the execution of digital product initiatives, with awareness of business value, user needs and technical feasibility.
* Apply value management principles to support prioritization decisions, linking epics, features and user stories to expected business outcomes, user impact, adoption goals and measurable value.
* Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, story clarification and acceptance activities to ensure delivery teams have clear priorities and are sprint\-ready.
* Act as the voice of the customer and business, balancing user needs, stakeholder expectations, dependencies and delivery constraints.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support MVP definition, release planning, testing, deployment and adoption of digital products.
* Track product performance, adoption indicators and delivery outcomes, and support continuous improvement through feedback loops and iteration.
* Support value tracking by defining relevant KPIs, benefits hypotheses and success metrics, and by using product feedback, usage data and stakeholder inputs to inform iteration and value realization.
* Apply understanding of product considerations such as usability, data quality, security and compliance in product requirement discussions.
* Bring experience in at least one sector or domain to inform use cases, workflows and prioritization decisions; life sciences or healthcare knowledge is a strong advantage.
* Prepare product updates, demos and working sessions for stakeholders, and support decision\-making through clear documentation and progress visibility.
* Contribute to agile, product management and value management best practices, reusable artifacts and continuous improvement across engagements, while ensuring product management remains the core delivery discipline.


**Must Have Skills:** 
 .
   

  

* Typically, 4–8 years of relevant experience in product ownership, business analysis, product management, digital product delivery or agile transformation roles.
* Working experience with product and delivery management tools including Jira, Aha! and Azure DevOps for roadmap planning, backlog management, sprint tracking, prioritization, release planning and cross\-functional delivery governance.
* Experience working on digital products, platforms or transformation initiatives in cross\-functional delivery environments.
* Strong understanding of agile product delivery practices including backlog management, user story creation, prioritization, sprint planning, acceptance criteria and release support.
* Working knowledge of value management in a product context, including value case support, benefits identification, KPI definition, outcome\-based prioritization and value realization tracking.
* Proven ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, engineers, architects, designers and data teams in a cross\-functional delivery environment.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clarify requirements, drive alignment and support delivery decisions.
* Experience in at least one sector or domain with the ability to apply contextual knowledge to product requirements and prioritization
* Familiarity with Agile / Scrum ways of working and experience supporting delivery of complex initiatives with quality and governance discipline.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Awareness of emerging technologies, analytics or automation capabilities that may support digital product innovation.
* Fundamental knowledge of and some experience with GenAI or Agentic AI concepts and use cases will be an added advantage.
* Experience working in regulated or data\-sensitive environments, especially life sciences, healthcare or adjacent sectors.
* Exposure to design thinking, customer journey mapping, service design, user\-centric requirement definition and value\-based prioritization approaches.
* Experience using value management artifacts such as value maps, benefits registers, KPI trees, OKRs or outcome roadmaps to support product decisions is preferred.
* Relevant certifications in Product Ownership, Agile, Scrum, Cloud or related disciplines.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Product Owner – AI/ML
description:
**Syncron** 
 is a leading SaaS company with over 20 years of experience, specializing in aftermarket solutions. Our Service Lifecycle Management Platform offers domain\-fit solutions for:
   

  

  

* Supply Chain optimization,
* Pricing strategy,
* Service Fulfillment (e.g. warranty management, field service management, service parts management, knowledge management).


 Our company has a global presence with offices in US, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Japan, Poland, India and group headquarters in Sweden.
   

  

 We build upon the belief that our greatest strength is our People. Our unique company culture has been appreciated by our Employees.
   

  

 With this we are
 **winning the hearts and minds of world\-leading organizations** 
 , such as JCB, Kubota, Electrolux, Toyota, Renault and Hitachi.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Owner** 
 to drive the delivery of AI/ML\-powered capabilities for Syncron's Contract Price SaaS platform. You will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Data Science, UX, and business stakeholders to transform customer needs into scalable product capabilities that improve pricing decisions, contract profitability, and customer outcomes.
   

  

 What would you do?
   

  

  

* Design and develop a customer onboarding and analytics configuration and deployment process to support Expert Services and Partner organizations
* Own the product backlog and end\-to\-end delivery of AI/ML features from discovery through release.
* Translate business needs into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
* Prioritize \& maintain the backlog based on customer value, business impact, technical dependencies, and product strategy.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, UX, Customer Success, and customers to define and deliver innovative AI\-powered solutions.
* Engage key technical and domain experts across our customers
* Drive Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Partner with ML Engineers and Data Scientists to deliver on roadmap requirements for predictive models, model evaluation, explainability, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Communicate roadmap, delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and release plans to stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Architecture teams to understand technical trade\-offs, platform \& product capabilities, and architectural decisions, ensuring product decisions support scalability, performance, security, and long\-term maintainability.
* Lead defect triage, manage technical debt, and ensure high\-quality product releases.
* Support release planning, documentation, product demonstrations, and customer enablement.
* Discover new ideas to incorporate AI into Product for new features, capabilities and improving stickiness of the product.
* Ensure AI/ML solutions deliver measurable business outcomes through improved pricing accuracy, profitability, and operational efficiency.


 What we expect
   

  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
* 7–12 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst in enterprise SaaS products.
* Experience delivering AI/ML or data\-driven products in an Agile environment and working with Data Scientists.
* Strong experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and analytical skills.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in Contract Pricing, CPQ, Pricing Optimization, Revenue Management, Service Lifecycle Management, Warranty, or Aftermarket solutions.
* Knowledge of AI/ML concepts such as predictive analytics, model evaluation, explainability, and MLOps.
* Hands on experience with GenAI, Agentic AI
* Experience working with cloud\-based B2B SaaS platforms, APIs, analytics, and data products.


 We offer:
   

  

**Unsure** 
 if you meet all the job requirements but passionate about the role?
 **Apply anyway!** 
 Syncron values diversity and welcomes all Candidates,
 **even** 
 those with non\-traditional backgrounds. We believe in transferable skills and a shared passion for success!
   

  

 The world is changing. Manufacturing companies are shifting from selling products to delivering services. And we are driving this transformation together with our Customers, by helping them reduce costs and manual processes. We are guiding them on their journey towards a fully connected service experience and making their brand stronger.
   

  

**Our go** 
**al: to make the complex simple.**
 Visit syncron.com to get to know us better!

title: Product Manager
description:
**About Certinal:** 




  





**Certinal** 
 is a unified Consent \& Compliance Platform that replaces paper\-based consent, manual intake, and uncontrolled forms with a single, fully digital system built for enterprise organizations. It digitally captures patient consent, enables legally binding electronic signatures, and ensures compliance with major regulations including HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, SOC 2 Type II, and CMS\-0053\-F, while integrating directly with EHR systems like Epic and Oracle Cerner.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




  





 Certinal is looking for a Product Manager to support the product team across discovery, specification and delivery for our e\-Signature and e\-Consent platform. You will work closely with engineering, design, sales and customer success to turn customer problems into shipped, well\-defined product.
 



  





 This is an execution\-focused role for someone early in their product career. You will write the stories, chase the details, keep the backlog honest and make sure what ships matches what was agreed. Because Certinal operates in regulated healthcare, you will also learn to treat audit trails, evidence and compliance requirements as first\-class product concerns rather than afterthoughts.
 



  





**Experience:** 
 4 to 8 years in product management or a closely related role, including a minimum of 1 year in healthcare SaaS.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria and product requirement documents from agreed problem statements.
* Groom and maintain the backlog alongside engineering and QA, and keep priorities, dependencies and status current.
* Participate in sprint planning, refinement and review, and unblock engineering questions during the sprint.
* Triage customer feedback, support tickets and field requests into themes with evidence and frequency attached.
* Run structured competitive teardowns of e\-signature and e\-consent products and keep a living comparison current.
* Translate regulatory and security requirements into testable acceptance criteria in partnership with Pre\-Sales and Engineering.
* Support release planning, write release notes, and prepare internal enablement material for Sales and Customer Success.
* Track adoption, funnel and usage metrics in product analytics, and report on how shipped features actually perform.
* Assist with beta and pilot programmes, including participant selection, feedback capture and readout.
* Contribute to user research: interview scheduling, note\-taking, synthesis and sharing findings with the team.
* Maintain product documentation so that internal teams have one accurate source of truth.



  





**Skills \& Experience Requirements:** 



* 4 to 8 years of experience in product management, business analysis, or an engineering, consulting or customer\-facing role with clear product exposure.
* Minimum 1 year of that experience in healthcare SaaS, with working understanding of clinical, compliance or provider workflows.
* Strong written communication; able to write a requirement that an engineer can build from without a follow\-up meeting.
* Structured problem\-solving and comfort breaking an ambiguous request into scoped, sequenced work.
* Hands\-on experience with an issue tracker such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Working familiarity with Figma and the ability to review and give useful feedback on designs.
* Basic SQL and comfort working with product analytics tools.
* Genuine curiosity about how enterprise software is bought, deployed and audited.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or an equivalent analytical discipline.



  





**Preferred:** 



* Exposure to B2B or enterprise SaaS rather than consumer products.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks and reading API documentation.
* Interest in or exposure to regulated domains such as healthcare, financial services or clinical research.
* Experience using AI tooling to accelerate research, synthesis or documentation work.
* Prior internship or project work in product management.



  





**Why Join Certinal?** 



* **Real Ownership Early:** 
 Own features end to end rather than sitting on the edge of someone else’s roadmap.
* **Learn a Hard Domain:** 
 Regulated healthcare product work builds judgement that transfers anywhere.
* **Close to Customers:** 
 Direct exposure to enterprise buyers through Sales, Pre\-Sales and Customer Success.
* **Small Team, Short Loops:** 
 Decisions get made quickly and you will see your work ship.
* **Learning \& Development:** 
 Professional development budget and mentorship from senior product leadership.

title: Software OTA Product owner
description:
**Why join Aptiv?**
 You'll have the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge applications, develop breakthrough technologies, and deliver innovative solutions to some of the world's leading automotive brands. See your work come to life on the road, helping make mobility safer, greener, and more connected. Ready to shape the future of mobility with us?
   

  

**YOUR ROLE**
 As a
 **SWDL/OTA Software Product Owner** 
 , you will own the vision, roadmap, backlog, and release outcomes for Aptiv's Software Download (SWDL) and Over\-the\-Air (OTA) platform solutions. You will serve as the bridge between customers, engineering teams, cybersecurity, diagnostics, validation, and vehicle platform stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and production\-ready software update capabilities for next\-generation connected vehicles.
   

  

* Own and prioritize the SWDL/OTA product backlog, translating customer, regulatory, and platform requirements into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Define and drive product roadmaps for software download, bootloader, OTA update, diagnostics, release management, and vehicle update capabilities.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including embedded software, cybersecurity, diagnostics, platform, validation, functional safety, manufacturing, and customer teams to ensure successful product delivery.
* Drive release planning, dependency management, risk mitigation, and scope decisions while ensuring predictable delivery and production readiness.
* Act as the primary stakeholder interface for SWDL/OTA programs, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, quality requirements, and business objectives.
* Ensure end\-to\-end update behavior including software flashing, OTA deployment, rollback, recovery, diagnostics, and release governance meets customer expectations and compliance requirements.


**YOUR BACKGROUND**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline.
* 7\-12 years of experience in automotive embedded software with demonstrated Product Owner, Product Management, Technical Program Management, or Systems Ownership experience.
* Strong domain knowledge of Software Download (SWDL), OTA/FOTA updates, Bootloader concepts, ECU flashing, diagnostics, UDS, DoIP, release management, and software lifecycle processes.
* Good understanding of Embedded C, AUTOSAR, MCAL, device drivers, HSM, CAN, Vector Stack, CANoe, DaVinci, Trace32 Lauterbach, Infineon AURIX, and NXP microcontroller platforms.
* Proven experience managing product backlogs, roadmaps, feature prioritization, stakeholder expectations, and cross\-functional dependencies in Agile environments.
* Strong communication, customer\-facing, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and business decisions.
* Experience with ASPICE, ISO 24089, UNECE R156, OTA platform solutions, automotive cybersecurity, and release governance is highly desirable.
* Experience supporting global OEM programs such as Ford, Stellantis, or other leading automotive manufacturers is a strong advantage.


**WHY JOIN US?**
* You can grow at Aptiv. Aptiv provides an inclusive work environment where all individuals can grow and develop, regardless of gender, ethnicity or beliefs.
* You can have an impact. Safety is a core Aptiv value; we want a safer world for us and our children, one with: Zero fatalities, Zero injuries, Zero accidents.
* You have support. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family and your physical and mental health with a competitive health insurance package.


**Your Benefits At Aptiv**
* Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development)
* Life and accident insurance
* Sodexo cards for food and beverages
* Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Job Title: Associate Product Manager – RF \& Antennas (Bangalore, India)** 




**Department: Product Management \- Marketing** 




  





**Company Overview:** 




 Abracon is a trusted supplier of leading\-edge and innovative electronic components including Frequency Control, Timing, Power, Magnetics, RF and Antenna solutions. Servicing world\-class companies across the data communication, transportation, industrial, medical, consumer, aerospace, and defense industries, Abracon accelerates customers’ time\-to\-market by providing unmatched product solutions, technical expertise, and service excellence.
 



  





**Position Summary:** 




 We are looking for a motivated, early\-career Associate Product Manager to support Abracon's RF \& Antennas product line, which includes embedded and external antennas, SAW and LTCC filters, and RF ICs. Reporting to the Senior Product Line Manager, you will handle day\-to\-day product support for sales, distribution partners, and customers, and contribute to the analysis and launch activities that drive the line's growth — while building the foundation to grow into a Product Line Manager role. This is a hands\-on opportunity to learn product management on the connectivity technologies behind IoT, automotive, industrial, and wireless infrastructure designs.
 



  





**Work Environment:** 




 The successful candidate will be a full\-time employee based at Abracon's office in Bangalore, India. A hybrid work\-from\-home arrangement is available. The role partners closely with the Senior Product Line Manager and headquarters teams in Austin, Texas, and requires regular overlap with U.S. business hours.
 



  





**Growth Opportunity:** 



* Learn product line management directly from a Senior Product Line Manager, with a clear path toward owning product families and, over time, a product line
* Build deep technical expertise in antennas, RF filtering, and wireless connectivity
* Support Tier 1 customers and distribution partners worldwide on next\-generation wireless designs
* Gain cross\-functional exposure to sales, engineering, operations, and marketing as part of Abracon's growing Bangalore team
* Opportunities for career advancement and meaningful impact in product development and marketing



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Serve as a regional point of contact for RF \& Antennas product inquiries from sales teams, representatives, distribution partners, and customers
* Support the Senior Product Line Manager on pricing and quotation requests, competitor cross\-references, and part number recommendations
* Coordinate sample requests, custom part number set\-ups, and datasheet, test report, and specification requests with engineering and operations
* Support new product introductions by gathering launch inputs, maintaining NPI documentation, and helping prepare launch collateral and sales training materials
* Assist with product lifecycle activities, including product change notifications (PCNs), last\-time\-buy, and end\-of\-life communications
* Conduct competitor benchmarking and market research on antenna, filter, and RF IC trends to inform product roadmaps and new product proposals
* Track product line sales, bookings, and design\-win activity; prepare reports and presentation materials for the Senior Product Line Manager and leadership reviews
* Maintain accurate product data across the website, distributor catalogs, and internal systems
* Relay customer requirements and market trends to the Senior Product Line Manager and engineering teams



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Electronics \& Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
* 2–3 years of experience in an engineering, applications, field application, product, or technical sales role, with an electronic component manufacturer or distributor
* Working knowledge of RF fundamentals, including impedance matching, S\-parameters, and antenna parameters (gain, efficiency, VSWR); hands\-on experience with a vector network analyzer is a plus
* Familiarity with wireless standards (e.g., Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular/LTE/5G, GNSS, UWB) is a plus
* Strong interest in product management and a basic understanding of the product lifecycle
* Solid analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and AI tools.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders
* Highly organized and responsive, with the ability to manage multiple requests in a fast\-paced environment and work effectively with global teams across time zones



  





**Come join our team!** 
 Excellence through teamwork drives the company culture at Abracon. We provide opportunities and support for your professional growth and empower each other in exercising our individual strengths.
 



  





 With a broad portfolio of passive and electromechanical timing, synchronization, power, connectivity and RF antenna solutions and more, Abracon helps engineers transform their ideas into products that meet future customer needs. For more information about Abracon, visit www.abracon.com

title: Senior AI Product Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced
 **AI Product Manager** 
 who can operate at the intersection of product, technology, client engagement, and execution. This is a high\-ownership, enterprise\-facing role for someone who is excited by the opportunity to shape cutting\-edge AI applications, work directly with international clients, and translate complex business problems into scalable AI\-enabled products.
   

  

 The AI Product Manager will lead the definition, shaping, and execution of enterprise AI products and features for global clients. This role requires a rare mix of product judgment, AI fluency, consulting maturity, and hands\-on problem solving. You will work closely with clients, engineering teams, designers, and delivery leaders to identify opportunities, define product direction, manage expectations, and bring AI\-first solutions to life.
   

  

 The ideal candidate understands how to apply GenAI and agentic patterns in enterprise contexts, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and is hands\-on enough to prototype ideas, validate concepts quickly, and sharpen requirements through action. description:
**Description**
 The Outbound and Flow team within Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) is looking for an experienced Product Manager (Technical) to own the vision and strategy for Routing and Mansort products, based out of Bangalore. Our team provides the products and services responsible for outbound fulfillment — ingesting shipments from upstream systems (SCOT) and processing them through picking, packing, and shipping. Our vision is to improve customer experience — Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), Speed, Quality, and Cost — while improving associate safety and simplifying our operations. We do so by building products that are highly reliable, resilient, self\-healing, scalable, extensible, and designed from the start with a focus on the safety and accessibility of our workforce.
   

  

 As a Product Manager (Technical) — L6 for Routing and Mansort, you will define, execute, and deliver a product roadmap that optimizes how units and packages are routed through the fulfillment center and how manual sortation (Mansort) operations are streamlined for throughput, quality, and cost. You will strongly influence the strategy and vision for the group, and develop and maintain product roadmaps and features grounded in team strategy. This role is inherently cross\-functional — you will work closely with engineering, science, operations, and business teams across geographies to launch features and build the tools and mechanisms that scale Routing and Mansort worldwide.
   

  

 A successful candidate will be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high\-quality, simple products, features, and applications. You will identify opportunities to make FC operations more efficient, and drive the design and development of software features to address them — leveraging and expanding current initiatives in Primitives and GenAI across the organization.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap priorities by working backward from customer needs, conducting research, analyzing usage data and market trends, and translating insights into clear problem statements and requirements.
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration with engineering, design, science, finance, and operations partners to deliver products on time and with high quality, aligning stakeholders and making smart trade\-offs when data is incomplete.
* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle from concept through launch and beyond, including defining success criteria and key performance indicators, monitoring operational health, and iterating based on performance metrics and customer feedback.
* Evaluate technical proposals and participate in architecture discussions, understanding how technical choices influence customer outcomes and balancing feature delivery with long\-term system health and scalability.
* Leverage generative AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate development cycles, improve decision\-making, and unlock new opportunities for product innovation.


**About The Team**
 AFT owns and operates the AFT Warehouse Management System (WMS) and select hardware — these technologies automate, orchestrate, and direct fulfillment in Amazon Robotics sort and non\-sort buildings, traditional sort and non\-sort buildings, IXDs, Fresh, Pantry, and Quick Deploy sites. AFT also owns and operates the FaaST WMS that runs in Vendor Flex buildings, India Mini\-FCs (small footprint, manual buildings in IN), and select Seller Flex locations (3P Sellers who are Prime\-enabled leveraging the FaaST WMS). AFT also owns the External Fulfillment Platform (EFP), which integrates 3P WMSes to the Amazon Supply Chain. AFT owns network infrastructure and devices in all building types including Sort Centers and Last Mile sites, and owns labor planning and scheduling technology leveraged for Fulfillment Centers in NA and EU and Sort Centers in NA.
   

  

 AFT General Summary
   

  

 Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers Amazon's global fulfillment network. description:
**About OnArrival** 




 OnArrival is a travel technology company enabling banks, fintechs, and consumer platforms to offer seamless travel experiences through our technology infrastructure.
 



 We are looking for a Product Manager to lead our Flights vertical and build reliable, scalable, and customer\-focused products. We want someone who is deeply comfortable using AI as part of everyday product work, not simply adding “AI\-powered” features to a roadmap.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Own the Flights product roadmap from discovery through execution.
* Improve search, booking, payments, and post\-booking experiences.
* Work closely with engineering, design, business, operations, and external partners.
* Use customer feedback, market insights, and product data to identify opportunities.
* Define requirements, prioritise initiatives, and drive products from concept to launch.
* Improve conversion, reliability, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
* Build scalable capabilities that can serve multiple enterprise customers.
* Track product performance and continuously improve key journeys.



  





**How We Expect You to Use AI** 




 At OnArrival, AI is part of how we work, think, and build. The ideal candidate should use AI meaningfully across the product lifecycle.
 



 You will be expected to:
 


* Use AI tools for research, competitive analysis, product discovery, and synthesising customer feedback.
* Analyse large volumes of support conversations, operational issues, and user behaviour to uncover patterns and opportunities.
* Create product specifications, user flows, edge\-case matrices, prototypes, and test scenarios faster and with greater depth.
* Use AI\-assisted prototyping and coding tools to validate ideas before committing significant engineering effort.
* Work with data and engineering teams to query, interpret, and visualise product data.
* Evaluate where AI can genuinely simplify customer journeys, reduce manual work, or improve decision\-making.
* Understand the practical strengths and limitations of LLMs, including hallucinations, latency, cost, privacy, evaluation, and human oversight.
* Define clear success metrics and evaluation frameworks for AI\-enabled product experiences.
* Think beyond chat interfaces and identify opportunities for intelligent recommendations, automation, personalisation, and agent\-led actions.
* Continuously experiment with new AI tools and help improve how the wider product organisation operates.



  





 You do not need to be an ML engineer. However, you should be technically curious, comfortable experimenting independently, and capable of working closely with engineering teams to turn AI possibilities into reliable products.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 3–5 years of product management experience.
* Prior experience in flights, airlines, OTAs, travel technology, or a closely related domain.
* Strong understanding of flight search, booking, ticketing, and post\-booking journeys.
* Experience working with airline, GDS, NDC, or travel\-supplier integrations.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and product execution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with engineering and understand API\-based products.
* Hands\-on experience using modern AI tools in day\-to\-day product work.
* Ability to distinguish meaningful AI applications from features driven purely by hype.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong ownership and comfort working through ambiguity.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience building B2B, B2B2C, embedded, or platform products.
* Exposure to payments, refunds, reconciliation, or travel operations.
* Experience with SQL, analytics platforms, experimentation, or rapid prototyping.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs, AI agents, prompt design, retrieval systems, or AI product evaluation.
* Experience launching an AI\-enabled customer or internal product.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Own a critical product vertical with significant business impact.
* Solve complex problems across travel, technology, commerce, and AI.
* Build products used by leading consumer platforms and their customers.
* Work closely with the founders and a strong cross\-functional team.
* Operate in a culture where product managers are expected to think, prototype, analyse, and execute.
* Help shape the next generation of embedded and intelligent travel experiences.
* If you understand flights deeply, think clearly about products, and already use AI to work faster and better, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Manager - Platform
description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.
   

  

 If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high\-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!
   

  

 Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a
 **Product Manager\-Platform** 
 to be part of making this/that happen.
   

  

**Position Overview And Objective**
 You'll join a team shaping the frontier of how AI and automated systems reach Arctic Wolf's platform. This posting covers two related focus areas: permissioning and access\-control systems (how system roles and access models work across single\-tenant and multi\-tenant/MSP customers), and developer platform and MCP (the public developer experience for discovering and adopting access to the platform). Through the interview process, we'll work with you to identify which focus area best fits your background and interests, so you don't need to know which one you are before applying.
   

  

 Both areas are technical and platform\-facing, and both will involve partnering closely with engineering on system design, including reviewing high\-level design documents (HLDs) and building prototypes or proofs of concept to validate direction before committing to full engineering investment. Depending on focus area, your work may be primarily internal\-facing (systems used by internal teams and technical partners) or may extend to a public\-facing surface, where developers and technical evaluators can explore and adopt platform capabilities before they're a customer at all.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and prioritize product requirements for new programmatic and AI\-driven access capabilities (API, protocol\-based, or natural\-language interfaces), or for the systems and roles that govern access to them.
* Partner with engineering on technical design and tradeoffs, including reviewing HLDs and providing product input on technical approach.
* Build prototypes and proofs of concept to validate product direction ahead of full engineering investment.
* Work cross\-functionally with engineering and business stakeholders to ensure new capabilities are properly scoped, tested, and governed before release.
* Represent the needs of the people and systems that depend on your area, whether internal technical partners, external developers, or both.
* Track adoption, usage, and technical health metrics to guide roadmap decisions.


**Experience \& Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally with technical, platform, or developer\-facing products.
* Experience in one or more of the following: role\-based access control (RBAC), identity, or permissioning systems across single\- or multi\-tenant models; or API/protocol design, developer platforms, and public/self\-serve product experiences.
* Comfortable partnering directly with engineers on technical specifications and tradeoffs, including reviewing and giving product input on technical design documents.
* Experience building prototypes or PoCs to validate product direction ahead of full engineering investment.
* Strong communicator able to translate between technical and business stakeholders.
* Thrives operating in an evolving architecture with real ambiguity, and is comfortable with scope shifting as the space matures.


**Why This Role**
 This is real technical ownership, not requirements administration. You'll partner directly with engineering on systems that the rest of the platform depends on, with genuine architectural input: reviewing HLDs, shaping tradeoffs, and building prototypes to test direction before engineering commits. You'll join a small team at the ground floor of one of the first governed AI\-access layers in the security industry, with a growth path shaped by how fast this space matures, not a fixed org chart.
   

  

**What You Get**
 Arctic Wolf is recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100, Fortune Cyber 60, and named a Top Workplace across multiple regions, backed by a platform trusted by 7,000\+ customers worldwide. In Bangalore, that comes with flexible annual leave and paid volunteer days, training and career development programs, comprehensive private medical coverage for you and your family, life insurance at 3x compensation, personal accident insurance, and fertility support and paid parental leave.
   

  

**On\-Camera Policy**
 To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location\-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
   

  

**About Arctic Wolf**
 At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021\-2025\), Best Places to Work – USA (2021\-2025\), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021\-2024\), Great Place to Work – UK (2024\-2026\), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024\-2026\). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.
   

  

**Our Values**
 Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization.  We are hiring a Sr. Data Product Manager to own a portfolio of Target Media data products end\-to\-end — from business definitions and contracts through datasets, pipelines, quality, governance, and delivery.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics and Media Partners. You will partner with DE day\-to\-day to build and evolve datasets and pipelines across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and contracts, and make sure the data products that result are trusted and well\-governed. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes. You will sit at the intersection of Roundel product, Data Engineering, MediaOps, and the broader Media Data Consumers.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
 We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager — Measurement \& Analytics to lead the strategy, development, and evolution of data products that enable marketing measurement and attribution across Target Media.
   

  

**Measurement – Must Have**
 This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing Measurement, Analytics and Data Engineering. You will own products that help the organization understand the impact of marketing investments across channels, campaigns, audiences, and customer journeys.
   

  

 The initial focus will be on Roundel and Target marketing spend, with the opportunity to expand measurement capabilities across loyalty, promotions, and other enterprise marketing investments.
   

  

 A core responsibility will be building and scaling attribution and measurement capabilities that connect marketing exposure and spend to business outcomes, enabling stakeholders to understand what worked, why it worked, and where to invest next.
   

  

 Analytics \& Data Fluency — Must Have
   

  

 Strong Working Knowledge Of Analytics And Data Concepts, With The Ability To Partner Effectively With Analytics Teams. You Should Be Comfortable With
   

  

* Customer\-level and aggregated analytics
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data pipelines and data transformations
* Data quality and reconciliation
* Metric definitions and semantic layers


 Building data products with Data Engineering
   

  

 You work hand\-in\-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs, prioritizing the backlog, and making trade\-off calls with DE on design and sequencing.
   

  

 Platform \& ecosystem stewardship
   

  

 Solid understand of Data Platform, cloud environment of GCP/BQ/PowerBI
   

  

 Trust, governance \& data quality — critical
   

  

 Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. As operational systems and automated workflows act on Roundel data, the cost of a stale or wrong data product rises sharply.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
* 10\+ years in product management, with meaningful time across Measurement, data products, data platforms, AdTech/MarTech, or retail media.
* Proven understanding Marketing Measurement concepts of Attribution, MTA, MMM, etc.
* Hands\-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritizing a technical backlog.
* Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (Lakehouse, data mesh, or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
* Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, and consent — treated as critical, not optional.
* Track record of translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and influencing cross\-functional partners without direct authority.
* Strong understand if PM Practices and working with Data Engineering, Analysts and Stakeholders.

TPM technology helps organizations establish a tamper resistant, hardware root of trust that’s at the hear of computing confidential data as well as establishing consistent security access and control.
   

  

 As the
 **Principal Product Manager** 
 for TPM/Attestation, you will drive product strategy and execution for the Windows TPM stack in partnership with internal and external partners such as hardware, OEM vendors, Microsoft cloud services like Intune, Azure Attestation and Azure Entra. You will engage directly with enterprise IT admins and IT leadership, and translate customer needs into roadmap and feature decisions spanning the Windows client, services, and cloud control plane.
   

  

 This is an individual\-contributor role based in Bangalore alongside the broader ENS IDC team.
   

  

 Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* 5\+ years of experience managing cross\-functional and/or cross\-team projects.
* Experience defining and shipping enterprise software, manageability, device management, or platform capabilities.

 Ecosystem \& Partner Engagement

title: Product Lead
description:
**About Digantara:** 




  





 Digantara is a leading Space Surveillance and Intelligence company focused on ensuring orbital safety and sustainability. With expertise in space\-based detection, tracking, identification, and monitoring, Digantara provides comprehensive domain awareness across various regimes, allowing end\-users to gain actionable intelligence on a single platform. At the core of its infrastructure lies a sophisticated integration of hardware and software capabilities aligned with the key principles of situational awareness: perception (data collection), comprehension (data processing), and prediction (analytics). This holistic approach empowers Digantara to monitor all Resident Space Objects (RSOs) in orbit, fostering comprehensive domain awareness.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We're looking for a Product Lead to own Digantara's SDA and conjunction\-analysis product line — from problem definition through global rollout. You'll work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with algorithms, data science and engineering teams to turn hard orbital and sensor\-fusion problems into product decisions that customers will pay for and rely on.
 



  





 You do not need to understand the underlying physics or astrodynamics. You do need to get to first principles fast, translate customer and business context into ruthless, defensible prioritisation, and own outcomes with real independence. You will be the primary product voice in front of defence, government and commercial customers worldwide, and you will largely determine not just execute — the roadmap and strategy for one of Digantara's most important products.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





**Product Strategy \& Prioritisation** 




  




* Own the vision, strategy and multi\-quarter roadmap for STARS Intelligence products, and defend it independently to leadership, customers and engineering.
* Drive prioritisation using customer needs, business impact and first\-principles reasoning — not engineering interest or research novelty alone.
* Make explicit trade\-off calls between depth (algorithmic sophistication) and speed\-to\-value for customers and be accountable for the outcomes of those calls.



  





**Customer \& Market Engagement** 




  




* Serve as the primary product interface to global customers — defence and government agencies, commercial satellite operators, and insurers/regulators — running discovery, validating problems, and shaping scope directly with them.
* Partner with Sales and Business Development on positioning, pricing and packaging of Intelligence products across government/defence and commercial segments, including support for proposals and technical/commercial conversations.



  





**Working With Algorithms \& Engineering** 




  




* Partner day\-to\-day with algorithms and data science teams to scope SDA capabilities into shippable product increments — asking the right questions without needing to derive the underlying models yourself.
* Write clear PRDs and specs that translate complex technical trade\-offs into unambiguous customer and business requirements.
* Define success metrics (accuracy, latency, coverage, customer outcomes) jointly with engineering and hold the roadmap accountable to them.
* Run planning and prioritisation forums, track delivery against roadmap, and unblock cross\-team dependencies.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* 6\+ years in product management, having owned a product's strategy and roadmap (ideally 0\-to\-1 or through a major scale\-up) in a technical, data\- or analytics\-heavy domain serving enterprise, government or defence customers.
* Roadmap and prioritisation: A demonstrated ability to drive prioritisation from customer and business impact and first\-principles reasoning, without needing subject\-matter depth (physics, orbital mechanics) to do it credibly.
* Stakeholder management: A track record of earning trust and driving decisions with highly technical teams — scientists, algorithm engineers, PhDs — as an equal partner rather than a backlog administrator.
* Real autonomy in prior roles: comfortable setting direction, making the call, and owning the outcome rather than waiting for it to be handed down.



  





**Location: Hebbal, Bangalore** 




**WFO 5 days from office.**

title: Senior Manager - Product Development
description:
Withum is a place where talent thrives \- where who you are matters. It’s a place of endless opportunities for growth. A place where entrepreneurial energy plus inclusive teamwork equals exponential results. Withum empowers clients and our professional staff with innovative tools and solutions to address their accounting, tax and overall business management and operational needs. As a US nationally ranked Top 25 firm, we recruit only the best and brightest people with a genuine passion for the business.
 



  





 The Innovation team is seeking a Senior Manager, Product Development, for the Firm's Innovation Department, based out of our Bangalore office. This is a technology leadership role accountable for the engineering organization that builds, maintains, supports, and automates the Firm's portfolio of custom products and solutions. The Senior Manager owns execution of engineering strategy, delivery, and run\-state health across that portfolio, and partners with product management and Firm leadership to ensure technical direction is inseparable from business outcomes.
 



  





 Withum’s brand is a reflection of our people, our culture and our strength. Withum has become synonymous with teamwork and client service excellence. The cornerstone of our success can truly be accredited to the dedicated professionals who work here every day, easy to work with a sense of purpose and caring for their co\-workers and whose mission is to help our clients grow and thrive. But our commitment goes beyond our clients as we continue to live the Withum Way, promoting personal and professional growth for all team members, clients, and surrounding communities.
 



  





 This role operates with authority over engineering priorities, release cadence, platform standards, and team capacity, and with a mandate to raise the quality, reliability, and consistency of engineering practice across product teams. The Senior Manager serves as the people leader for engineers, automation developers, and technical leads — coaching them, setting the technical bar, and holding accountability for what the team ships and for how well it runs once it is live.
 



  





  





**How You’ll Spend Your Time:** 




 Technology Vision and Engineering Strategy
 



 · Craft and communicate an inspirational technical vision for the product portfolio, articulating clearly how individual products, platforms, and services come together into one coherent engineering estate.
 



 · Partner proactively with Firm leaders to define and evolve the end\-state architecture, ensuring solutions are secure, resilient, performant, and scalable.

 · Drive the platform and data architecture roadmap, eliminating non\-strategic connections, brittle integrations, and manual batch handoffs.

 Product Development and Delivery

title: Director, Software Engineering - Agentic AI
description:

 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
   

  

 A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
   

  

 Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Equinix Incubation builds the agentic systems that run the software delivery lifecycle end to end: a fleet of specialized AI agents, with humans directing the work and owning every gate. Someone has to own the product, the roadmap, and the team behind it. That is this role.
   

  

 You will lead the engineering pods that build the orchestration layer, the persona consoles, and the agents themselves, and carry the roadmap from first MVP to organization\-wide scale. This is a player\-coach role for a leader who can hold a product vision, an architecture, an executive audience, and a hiring plan in their head at the same time.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Own the Product and the Roadmap
   

  

* Define and drive the delivery\-engine roadmap: orchestrator, agent fleet, consoles, dashboards, and enterprise integrations, sequenced for value
* Make the build\-measure\-learn loop real: ship in sprints, pilot with live delivery teams, and let adoption and telemetry reshape the plan
* Own trade\-off decisions across scope, quality, cost, and speed, and defend them with data in front of senior leadership


 Build and Lead the Pods
   

  

* Hire, grow, and retain a small, exceptional team of agent engineers, platform engineers, and delivery talent across the UK and India
* Run lean pods where agents do the routine work and people do the judgment work; model that way of working yourself
* Set a high, kind bar: clear expectations, honest feedback, and career growth in the most modern engineering discipline there is


 Prove the Value
   

  

* Own the value story: cycle time, throughput, quality, adoption, and realized business value, instrumented and reported without drama
* Keep the economics honest: agent cost, platform cost, and capacity unlocked, treated as first\-class engineering metrics
* Turn pilot wins into an expansion case that finance and function leaders believe


 Set the Operating Standard
   

  

* Establish how agent\-first engineering is done: evals as release gates, human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, and responsible AI governance with InfoSec and the AI council
* Represent the platform in architecture and governance forums, and keep the roadmap aligned with enterprise platform and data strategy
* Share patterns, standards, and playbooks so other teams can adopt what your team proves


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* The delivery engine is in daily use by live delivery teams, with measurable cycle\-time and quality gains that survive finance scrutiny

**Experience: 3 \- 4 Years** 




**Location: Bengaluru, India (On\-Site)** 




**Type: Full\-Time** 




**Compensation: ₹7 to ₹10 LPA (CTC)** 




  





**About Stance Health** 





 Stance Health is an evidence\-backed physiotherapy and performance healthcare company focused on injury prevention, pain management, movement optimization, rehabilitation, and performance enhancement.
 





 Through technology\-backed assessments, evidence\-based treatment protocols, and long\-term strength programs, we help individuals recover better, move better, and perform at their highest potential.
 





 We currently operate 5 centres across Bengaluru — HSR, Whitefield, Indiranagar, JP Nagar and Koramangala — delivering 5,000\+ sessions every month.
 





 As we continue expanding across Bengaluru, we are building the systems, growth engines, partnerships, and operating capabilities required to scale Stance into a leading high\-performance healthcare brand.
 




  





**About the Role** 





 We are looking for an Associate – Founders’ Office to work closely with the founding team on high\-priority business initiatives across growth, revenue, partnerships, expansion, and operations.
 
 ﻿
 






 This is a high\-ownership role with significant exposure to the business. You will be expected to take initiatives from problem identification through execution and measurement, working across functions and directly with external stakeholders where required.
 





 The role will involve both strategic problem\-solving and hands\-on execution. Depending on the initiative, your work could range from identifying a new growth opportunity and developing the approach to executing a partnership, supporting a new centre launch, running an on\-ground activation, or analysing the performance of an initiative and determining the next course of action.
 





 This role requires someone who is comfortable operating in an environment where the problems are not always clearly defined and where ownership extends beyond a fixed functional responsibility.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 





 1\.
 
**Growth \& Revenue** 



* Work with the founders to identify and execute opportunities to drive revenue and customer growth.
* Develop and execute initiatives across customer acquisition, retention, referrals, partnerships, and new revenue channels.
* Support the development and execution of go\-to\-market strategies for new services, programs, and offerings.
* Evaluate pricing, packaging, and monetization opportunities.
* Track the performance of growth initiatives and identify opportunities for improvement.




 2\.
 
**Partnerships \& Business Development** 



* Identify and evaluate potential partnerships across relevant businesses, institutions, communities, corporates, and other external stakeholders.
* Initiate conversations, manage follow\-ups, and drive partnerships through to execution.
* Build and maintain relationships with external stakeholders.
* Develop partnership proposals and support commercial discussions.
* Measure partnership performance and identify opportunities to scale successful initiatives.



**3\. Expansion \& GTM** 



* Support the expansion of Stance across Bengaluru through market research, location evaluation, and launch execution.
* Conduct on\-ground research to assess potential locations, customer segments, competitors, and market opportunities.
* Support new centre launches across planning, partnerships, local activation, and execution.
* Assist in evaluating new business opportunities and expansion initiatives.
* Coordinate across internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely execution of launches and pilots.



**4\. On\-Ground Execution** 



* Plan and execute events, activations, campaigns, and other customer\-facing initiatives.
* Coordinate with vendors, partners, institutions, and other external stakeholders.
* Conduct centre visits and on\-ground market assessments as required.
* Identify execution gaps and resolve operational issues independently.
* Ensure initiatives are executed within defined timelines and objectives.



**5\. Business Operations** 



* Identify operational bottlenecks and work with relevant teams to implement solutions.
* Translate business priorities into structured execution plans.
* Drive cross\-functional initiatives and ensure clear ownership and follow\-through.
* Support the implementation and improvement of processes as the business scales.
* Monitor execution against agreed objectives, timelines, and performance metrics.



**6\. Data \& Business Performance** 



* Track key business metrics across revenue, growth, customer acquisition, partnerships, and centre performance.
* Analyse business and operational data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring intervention.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports for business reviews.
* Evaluate the performance of experiments and initiatives and recommend next steps.
* Present findings and recommendations to the founding team in a clear and structured manner.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 





 We are looking for someone who has demonstrated ownership of business initiatives and the ability to take them from planning to execution.The ideal candidate will have experience in areas such as:
 



* Business growth and revenue
* Business development and partnerships
* Startup or business operations
* GTM and expansion
* Project or initiative ownership
* On\-ground execution
* Events, launches, campaigns, or activations
* Cross\-functional business initiatives




 Your previous job title is less important than the scope of work you have actually handled and the outcomes you have delivered.
 




**We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in environments where they were required to operate independently, manage multiple stakeholders, solve ambiguous problems, and take responsibility for outcomes.** 




  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 3–4 years of relevant professional experience in business growth, business development, operations, partnerships, GTM, or similar execution\-oriented roles.
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* Strong commercial and business understanding.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage and execute cross\-functional initiatives.
* Proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets.
* Strong stakeholder management and follow\-through.
* Comfortable with regular on\-ground work and travel across Bengaluru as required..
* Comfortable working 6 days from the office.



**Note: No postgraduate qualification is required or preferred. Business Analyst roles would not be the right fit.** 




  





**Who Will Succeed in This Role \-** 

 The role is suited to someone who:
 



* Takes ownership without requiring constant direction.
* Can move comfortably between analysis, decision\-making, and execution.
* Is commercially minded and understands the connection between initiatives and business outcomes.
* Can work with founders as well as internal and external stakeholders.
* Is comfortable dealing with ambiguity and changing priorities.
* Can structure an unclear problem and independently determine the next steps.
* Has a strong bias towards execution and measurable outcomes.
* Is comfortable working across functions rather than operating within a narrowly defined role.



  





**What This Role Is Not** 





 This is not a pure analytics, reporting, recruitment, product management, or coordination role.
 





 The position requires meaningful involvement in business execution, growth, partnerships, expansion, and operations. Candidates whose experience is primarily limited to analysis, reporting, functional support, or specialist responsibilities may not be the right fit.
 




  





**Why Join Stance Health** 



* Work directly with the founding team on high\-priority business initiatives.
* Exposure across growth, revenue, partnerships, operations, and expansion.
* Opportunity to contribute to new centre launches and business\-building initiatives.
* High level of ownership and visibility into business decisions.
* Opportunity to work in a rapidly expanding healthcare and performance business.
* Direct exposure to the process of scaling a multi\-centre healthcare brand.



  





**If you are interested in building businesses, solving complex problems, and taking ownership of execution, we would like to hear from you.**

description:
**Company Description**
**ServiceNow**
 It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI\-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud\-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.
   

  

 Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce.
   

  

 Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.
   

  

 Moveworks is trusted by over 5\.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award.
   

  

 In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.
   

  

 By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high\-growth company. We are looking for world\-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business.
   

  

 Come join us!
   

  

**Job Description**

 As an Engineering Manager on the Product and Platform org at Moveworks, you will lead a team of strong engineers. The team will focus on developing user facing product features that leverage our advanced Machine Learning platform. In addition, you will design scalable frameworks to support rapid feature development and deployment. You will be working cross\-functionally with other teams regularly to design and deploy features and tools that our customers use every day. Your role is absolutely critical here at Moveworks, and you will see the immediate impact of your work on both customers and other engineers.
   

  

 If you are passionate about full\-stack product development, curious about machine learning, enjoy working alongside equally driven colleagues, and are an experienced engineer looking for a new challenge, we should have a conversation!

* You feel at home developing on Linux with languages like Python and/or Golang

title: Product Consultant - CS
description:
**Product Consultant** 




 Customer Success · Individual Contributor
 



  





**About Superset** 




 Superset is India's largest campus recruitment platform. We help large enterprises run end\-to\-end fresher hiring outreach, applications, assessments, interviews, hiring ops, and analytics at scale. Beyond hiring workflows, we power candidate engagement programs, competitions, hackathons, and learning journeys that make Superset the platform of choice for enterprises that want to build a brand on campus, not just fill seats. Our clients include marquee names across BFSI, IT, consulting, and manufacturing. You'll work directly with hiring and talent acquisition teams at large companies and own outcomes that impact thousands of candidates.
 



  





 Working at Superset means operating in a high\-engagement, high\-variety environment. Every week brings new client contexts, new problem shapes, and new stakeholders. If you're someone who learns fastest when thrown into the deep end and likes to make sense of complexity on the fly, this is your kind of place.
 



  





 We invest continuously in internal learning through peer sessions, structured capability\-building, and cross\-functional exposure. As a Product Consultant, you're expected to be both a practitioner and a multiplier: someone who raises the bar for the team around them, not just someone who delivers for their own portfolio.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists** 




 Enterprises don't buy "a product". They buy a result: smoother hiring, faster closures, fewer ops headaches, and a confident team on the other side.
 



  





 This role owns that result. You step in when client situations need expert judgment, strategic solutioning, or delivery ownership that goes beyond day\-to\-day account management. You will work alongside CSMs (
 *who handle daily client relationships* 
 ) and serve as the escalation and solutioning layer that the person the team calls when things get complex.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Understand client hiring workflows and tailor Superset to their needs—owning post\-sales delivery with a hands\-on, customised approach (
 *not a generic walk\-through* 
 ).
* Go beyond surface requirements: identify the actual bottleneck, the hidden constraints, and what "success" truly means for each client.
* Lead implementations and POCs: scope, plan, execute, and make sure the client sees value fast.
* Own complex escalations solutioning, delivery decisions, and edge cases that the CSM layer escalates upward.
* Run client conversations with confidence even when the room is sceptical, confused, or unconvinced. Keep the ball in your court.
* Storyboard the solution: stitch a clear narrative for why the approach works and how the rollout will happen.
* Manage senior stakeholders (TA, HRBP, business leaders, ops, IT) across the client org align them, handle objections, move things forward without harming trust.
* Treat internal teams as customers too: validate asks, prioritise correctly, and sell the right work internally to get things done.
* Solve problems by connecting dots use existing tools and processes first; when enhancement is needed, articulate impact on business and other clients.
* Support pre\-sales on enterprise deals: solutioning conversations, SOW reviews, and client presentations alongside the sales team.
* Own outcomes end\-to\-end: adoption, usage, renewals (where applicable), and overall project success. No handoff and disappear.
* Mentor the CSM team set escalation standards, review their work, and be the person they turn to when a situation gets tough.
* Write approach notes and solution documents: structured thinking on paper that a client or internal stakeholder can act on without a follow\-up call.
* Deeply understand customer problems before jumping to solutions diagnosis first, prescription second.
* Run internal upskilling sessions with the team: share learnings from complex engagements, build playbooks, and raise the average capability of the CS function.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Core requirements:** 



* 7–10\+ years in consulting, enterprise SaaS, HR tech, or client\-facing implementation roles.
* Sharp requirement discovery you get to the crux quickly and ask the uncomfortable but necessary questions.
* Strong product understanding: you can translate features into real business workflows, not just talk about them.
* High EQ and executive communication you can build comfort and trust with senior stakeholders, fast.
* Storytelling ability: you can structure messy inputs into a clear plan and narrative.
* Ownership mindset: end\-to\-end accountability, not task completion.
* Bias for action fail fast, learn fast, iterate fast.



  





**Strong signals:** 



* Exposure to recruitment, HR tech, assessments, or workforce solutions.
* Comfort holding a room recovering a drifting call, de\-escalating tension, and still driving to a decision.
* Track record of being trusted with client relationships that required more than relationship management.
* Having experience working in fast\-paced and fast\-growing organisations



  





**What This Role Is Not** 




 We want to be direct so there are no surprises:
 


* Not a daily account management role CSMs own that layer.
* Not a traditional people manager role but you will mentor and guide the team on complex situations, run upskilling sessions, and set the standard for how the CS function operates.



  





**What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)** 



* You independently run client discovery and implementation calls without hand\-holding.
* Pick a project, deliver it end\-to\-end yourself, and ensure it creates a “wow” outcome for the customer with clear business impact and problem resolution.
* You've built strong relationships with key client stakeholders and become their go\-to person.
* You've improved at least one internal playbook docs, process, or templates based on real learnings.
