title: Sr. Technical Product Manager-Networking and Switches
description:
We are seeking a deeply technical product leader to take ownership of our extensive Networking and Switches portfolio: secure console servers, managed and unmanaged PoE Ethernet switches, media converters, industrial connectivity, and serial extension solutions. This product line is central to our customers' operations across datacom, industrial, and secure government environments. We are looking for a technical authority who will drive portfolio optimization, OEM/ODM vendor management, and rigorous quality assurance, sitting at the intersection of deep hardware engineering, and product lifecycle execution. This role can be based in our Plano, TX, Lawrence, PA, or India offices to allow for direct, hands\-on access to our hardware labs, though remote (US) arrangements will be considered for exceptional candidates.
 



  





  





  





**What You Will Do** 



* Technical Portfolio Strategy and Optimization: Evaluate the existing networking, converter, and console server portfolio to drive SKU rationalization, BOM optimization, and margin improvement. Identify which products to consolidate or sunset and which high\-margin lines to scale.
* OEM/ODM Vendor Architecture and Management: Act as the primary technical interface with our global manufacturing partners. Influence their roadmaps, negotiate technical SLAs, and drive root\-cause analysis and supplier quality corrections for field failures.
* Rigorous Product Engineering and QA Leadership: Own the firmware and hardware validation gate. Design and execute New Product Introduction testing, regulatory compliance verification, and automated test frameworks.
* Level 3 Escalation Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for complex field failures. Perform hands\-on debugging in the lab, translate field data into engineering requirements, and enforce corrective actions with vendors.
* Engineering Impact of Compliance and Certification: Partner with the Compliance Manager, who tracks market mandates and certification requirements. You translate those mandates into hardware and firmware requirements, evaluating vendor BOMs and architectures so that component or firmware changes do not silently invalidate FIPS, TAA, UL, NERC CIP, and other relevant standards.
* Lifecycle and Knowledge Execution: Manage the product lifecycle from NPI through End\-of\-Life. Build the technical documentation, training material, troubleshooting guides, firmware test checklists, and compatibility matrices that empower support, Product Ops, and adjacent product managers.
* Cross\-Portfolio Technical Collaboration: Act as the networking subject matter expert for the broader product organization, supporting Sales and Product Marketing with technical content.



  





  





**Core Technical Expertise** 



* Layer 2 and Layer 3 Networking Standards: VLANs (802\.1Q), Spanning Tree Protocols (STP/RSTP/MSTP), link aggregation (LACP), QoS/CoS prioritization, IP routing (Static, OSPF), IGMP snooping, and security mechanisms like 802\.1X and ACLs.
* Media Conversion and Physical Layer Mechanics: Optical and copper interfaces (SFP/SFP\+, RJ\-45, single\-mode vs. multi\-mode fiber, wavelength specifications), Power over Ethernet standards, and rate\-matching mechanics.
* PoE System Engineering: PSE/PD classification and power budget validation across 802\.3af, 802\.3at, intelligent detection and backward\-compatibility behavior, and downstream device power profiling.
* Harsh\-Environment and Industrial Specifications: Industrial hardening, wide operating temperatures, high EMC/EMI immunity, redundant power inputs, ring redundancy protocols, and DIN\-rail or panel\-mount deployment.
* Out\-of\-Band Management and Connectivity Protocols: Console server architectures, secure out\-of\-band access, terminal emulation, serial\-over\-IP encapsulation, and USB extension technology.
* Security, Authentication, and Compliance Implementation: How standards are physically and logically implemented in networking gear, including TPM 2\.0, FIPS 140\-2/3 validated cryptographic modules, TAA\-compliant supply chains, and NERC CIP supporting features; AAA frameworks (TACACS\+, RADIUS, Kerberos, 802\.1X) and VPN technologies (OpenVPN, IPsec) as applied to secure out\-of\-band platforms; plus ZTP, RESTful API, and SNMP/LLDP/NTP integration.
* Serial and Signal Extension Technologies: Classic serial interfaces (RS\-232, RS\-422, RS\-485\) and V.35/Coax signal conversion, along with the electrical principles of signal attenuation, impedance matching, and long\-distance copper extension.
* OT and Industrial Serial Practice: Modbus ASCII/RTU over RS\-422/485, and serial line conditioning including bias, termination, isolation (e.g., 2\-kV), and surge protection.



  





  





**Who Will Succeed in This Role** 



* You are a hands\-on technical leader who is just as comfortable reading a market trend report as you are hooking up a serial cable to debug a spanning\-tree loop in the lab.
* You have experience managing OEM/ODM relationships and know how to hold external engineering teams accountable to strict quality and firmware standards.
* You understand that in an extensive hardware portfolio, strategy is realized through rigorous execution, BOM optimization, and reliable technical sustainment
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; OR equivalent hands\-on experience with a proven track record in hardware validation and network engineering.
* Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network\+, or equivalent industrial networking certifications are highly preferred and can substitute for formal education requirements.



  





  





**EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; OR equivalent hands\-on experience with a proven track record in hardware validation and network engineering.
* Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network\+, or equivalent industrial networking certifications are highly preferred and can substitute for formal education requirements.

 If you want an environment where technical depth is respected, product craft is expected, and the roadmap has real revenue and enterprise weight behind it, this is that seat.
 



  





  





**What You Will Own** 








* Platform strategy and roadmap \- outcomes, sequencing, and trade\-offs across a 12–18 month horizon. Build ground\-up product stories from customer signals, QBR data, competitive analysis and platform reality. You are not processing inbound requests.
* Platform APIs and payload surface — including AMD, recording status callbacks, disconnectedBy, throttling APIs, and the next generation of programmable platform primitives.
* Enterprise platform deployments
* Cross\-product platform integrations \- with platformbot, CQA, contact centre, and streaming.
* The developer and enterprise customer experience \- including QBR ownership on top 20 accounts and Developer NPS \>45 across the API surface.
* Build ground\-up product stories from customer signals, QBR data, competitive analysis, and platform reality — not just processing inbound requests.








  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  





 We care more about what you have actually owned than your previous title.
 



 You have ideally:
 


* Built real systems as an engineer, and now want to own the product decisions behind them.
* Spent at least 3\-4 years operating in technically complex domains — CPaaS, telephony, developer platforms, API\-first products, data infrastructure or equivalent.
* Read system design docs, held your own in a review with a staff engineer, and known when an engineering estimate is soft.
* Written PRDs engineers actually reference.
* Done real discovery and built user stories from first principles.
* Defended prioritisation with data.
* Taken vague mandates and converted them into executable roadmaps without heavy hand\-holding.
* Committed publicly and held yourself accountable, including to slips.
* Known when to move fast and when to wait, when to be direct and when to be diplomatic, when to hold a scope and when to renegotiate.



  





  





**This Role May Be a Strong Fit If You Are** 




 A senior or staff engineer considering a product move. If your technical depth is real and your appetite for product craft is genuine, apply and tell us how you are thinking about the transition. We have seen this path produce some of the best technical PMs in our space.
 








 A product manager from a CPaaS\-adjacent developer platform — auth, messaging, payments, analytics infrastructure. The domain\-specific telephony knowledge can be built. The platform thinking and API\-product craft cannot.
 



  





  





 This is probably not the right role if:
 



  




* Your experience is primarily roadmap execution and processing inbound requests.
* You have not worked in a technically complex domain and do not want to start.
* You need a well\-defined mandate and close supervision to make progress.

title: People Technology Product Manager
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 


**The Enterprise Technology Team** 

 The Enterprise Technology team builds and delivers the secure, scalable systems that power how our business runs. Our People Technology Team sits at the heart of this work, overseeing the full Hire\-to\-Retire technical ecosystem—including core applications like Workday, Greenhouse, and Cornerstone—and ensuring these platforms evolve alongside the company's growth. We partner closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Business Operations to bring data\-driven, compliant, and innovative solutions to life.
 


**The Opportunity** 

 Reporting to the Director of People Technology, this role will serve as the Product Manager for Okta's People Technology portfolio, focused on Employee Growth \& Talent. You will act as the strategic bridge between global People leaders and delivery teams. You will translate strategic product visions into high\-velocity execution — shaping the what and why in partnership with Digital Solutions and People leadership, and partnering with the Delivery Lead on the how and when — while navigating complex enterprise workflows across Talent Acquisition (Greenhouse), Learning \& Development (Cornerstone), Talent Management (Workday), and AI\-driven automation.
 


**What You'll Do** 
* **Product Strategy \& Roadmap Leadership:** 
 Define the multi\-year product vision and strategy for the Growth \& Talent domain in close collaboration with functional and technical leadership. Translate that strategy into a prioritized, outcome\-driven roadmap that articulates clear business value, return on investment (ROI), and measurable impact on talent operations and employee experience.
* **Talent Ecosystem Modernization:** 
 Build data\-driven business cases and functional strategies for major platform initiatives across the talent ecosystem (e.g., ATS, LMS, and custom Workday Extend applications), articulating clear ROI, operational efficiency gains, and improved employee and candidate experiences.
* **Delivery Lead Partnership:** 
 Partner closely with the Growth \& Talent Delivery Lead to translate business priorities and functional requirements into well\-scoped epics and user stories, while maintaining clear alignment on trade\-offs, velocity, and delivery milestones.
* **Functional \& Technical Alignment:** 
 Act as the voice of the business and end users within technical discussions, translating complex functional requirements into clear product specifications and acceptance criteria. Partner with the delivery team to evaluate technical trade\-offs, balancing user experience, operational risk, and long\-term scalability.
* **AI \& Talent Automation Strategy:** 
 Define the strategy and functional requirements for integrating AI across the talent lifecycle (sourcing, onboarding, learning, internal mobility)—evaluating build vs. buy solutions, designing human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, and ensuring enterprise\-grade privacy and ethical AI standards.
* **Global Stakeholder Management:** 
 Drive cross\-functional alignment across Digital Solutions, distributed executive stakeholders, business functional leads, and US\-based product counterparts to ensure clear visibility, smooth change management, and high program adoption.


**What You Bring to Okta** 
* 8\+ years of Product Management experience leading internal enterprise platforms, enterprise HR/Talent systems, or complex B2B SaaS products at global scale.
* **Deep Talent Tech Domain Expertise:** 
 In\-depth understanding of core Talent Acquisition, Learning \& Development, and Performance/Talent Management processes, with hands\-on familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Greenhouse, Cornerstone, and Workday Talent (or equivalent ATS/LMS/HCM ecosystems).
* **Strategic Business Case \& ROI Sizing:** 
 Proven ability to translate long\-term business goals into multi\-year product strategies, build data\-backed investment cases, and measure the tangible ROI and operational impact of platform initiatives.
* **Technical Fluency \& Cross\-Functional Translation:** 
 Demonstrated track record partnering with delivery teams on system integrations, data flows, and technical trade\-offs—translating complex business requirements into clear functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and PRDs.
* **AI \& Automation Acumen:** 
 Functional understanding of enterprise AI applications, generative AI capabilities, and automated workflows, with an appreciation for human\-in\-the\-loop design, ethical AI, and data privacy safeguards.
* **Autonomous Global Leadership:** 
 Proven success operating with high autonomy across distributed time zones (US / APAC / EMEA), driving alignment and influencing senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams asynchronously.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.


**Preferred Qualifications** 
* Experience scoping and delivering solutions on enterprise platform extensibility frameworks (e.g., Workday Extend, orchestration engines, or custom application ecosystems).
* Direct experience conceptualizing, testing, or deploying agentic AI workflows, conversational interfaces, or autonomous task automation in an enterprise HR context.

title: Senior Product Manager - Search
description:
**Company Overview** 




  





**Nykaa Fashion** 
 is one of India's leading fashion and lifestyle destinations, offering a curated selection of apparel, footwear, accessories, jewellery, and home products from both global and homegrown brands. Operating on an omnichannel model with a robust digital presence, Nykaa Fashion delivers a seamless and personalized shopping experience to millions of customers across the country. Driven by technology, data, and a strong focus on customer experience, Nykaa Fashion is redefining the way India discovers and shops for fashion.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a Senior Product Manager – Product Discovery, you will own the customer experience across Search and Product Listing Pages (PLPs), helping millions of users effortlessly discover products that best meet their needs.
 



 Your mission is to simplify product discovery by designing intuitive browsing and shopping experiences that reduce friction, minimize cognitive overload, and enable customers to make confident purchase decisions. You will shape how customers navigate large product catalogs, refine choices, explore relevant products, and discover inspiration—all while balancing customer experience with business outcomes.
 



 This role is ideal for someone with exceptional product intuition, strong analytical thinking, and a deep appreciation for user experience design. You should enjoy solving ambiguous consumer problems, using customer insights and experimentation to guide decisions, and partnering closely with Design to build elegant, scalable experiences.
 



 You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Data Science, Merchandising, and Business teams to define the future of product discovery at Nykaa.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Own the Product Discovery Experience** 



* Define and drive the long\-term vision and roadmap for discovery experiences across Search and Product Listing Pages.
* Continuously improve how customers browse, evaluate, compare, and discover products across large and diverse catalogs.
* Design intuitive customer journeys that reduce effort and help users quickly find products that best match their intent.
* Balance inspiration and efficiency by creating experiences that support both exploratory browsing and goal\-oriented shopping



**2\. Build Best\-in\-Class Browsing Experiences** 



* Design intuitive filtering, sorting, navigation, and product refinement experiences that simplify customer decision\-making.
* Continuously improve discovery flows by reducing friction, eliminating unnecessary complexity, and making interfaces easier to navigate.
* Partner closely with Design to create clean, elegant, and scalable shopping experiences that prioritize usability and clarity.
* Leverage customer insights to improve how information is presented, helping users make confident purchasing decisions with less effort.



**3\. Leverage AI to Improve Customer Discovery** 



* Identify opportunities where AI can meaningfully enhance product discovery and customer decision\-making.
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering teams to build intelligent discovery experiences using customer behavior, personalization signals, and modern AI capabilities.
* Explore emerging interaction models, including conversational and intent\-aware experiences, where they create measurable customer value.
* Ensure AI\-powered experiences remain intuitive, trustworthy, and easy to understand.



**4\. Drive Product Decisions Through Data** 



* Build a strong experimentation culture through rigorous A/B testing and hypothesis\-driven product development.
* Analyze customer behavior, browsing journeys, funnel metrics, and product discovery patterns to uncover improvement opportunities.
* Define and own key product metrics related to discovery efficiency, engagement, customer satisfaction, and business impact.
* Combine quantitative analysis with qualitative customer research to deeply understand user needs and validate product decisions.



**5\. Lead Cross\-functional Execution** 



* Lead large, cross\-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Data Science, Merchandising, and Business teams.
* Translate customer problems into clear product strategies, PRDs, and measurable success metrics.
* Influence senior stakeholders through structured thinking, customer insights, and data\-backed decision\-making.
* Mentor product managers and contribute to strengthening product management practices across the organization.



  





**Required Skillset** 




  




* Academic Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree from a Tier 1 institution, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
* Experience \- 5\+ years of Product Management experience building customer\-facing products in consumer internet or B2C e\-commerce companies. Experience in beauty, fashion, marketplace, or retail e\-commerce is preferred
* Demonstrated ownership of complex product areas with measurable customer and business impact.
* Product Thinking \& UX \- Exceptional product sense with a strong understanding of customer behavior and shopping journeys.
* Proven experience designing intuitive consumer experiences in partnership with Product Design teams.
* Ability to simplify complex workflows into elegant, easy\-to\-use customer experiences.
* Strong appreciation for interaction design, information architecture, and usability principles.
* Analytical Excellence\- Strong analytical skills with expertise in product metrics, funnel analysis, experimentation, and behavioral analytics
* Technical Fluency \- Comfortable working with Engineering and Data Science teams to build scalable consumer products. Ability to understand technical trade\-offs and collaborate effectively on AI\-enabled product capabilities without needing deep machine learning expertise.
* Leadership \- Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional leadership skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to influence across teams and senior leadership



  





**Good to Have** 




 • Prior experience with search platforms, recommendation systems, or catalog quality tooling.
 



 • Exposure to LLM\-based product development, prompt engineering, or AI product prototyping.
 



 • Familiarity with beauty, fashion, or lifestyle e\-commerce and the nuances of catalog\-driven search.

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.

 We are seeking an experienced Senior
 **Product Manager – Payroll, Time \& Attendance**

 The successful candidate will combine deep expertise in Workday Payroll and Time with broader payroll ecosystem knowledge, and have experience managing large\-scale transformation programmes, vendor\-managed services, integrations, automation, and operational excellence initiatives.
   

  

 This is a strategic leadership role responsible for ensuring payroll technology enables accurate, compliant, scalable, and efficient payroll operations while supporting the broader HR transformation agenda.

 Product Strategy \& Roadmap

* Develop and maintain a multi\-year product roadmap covering payroll modernization, automation, simplification, compliance, and user experience improvements.
* Evaluate future\-state operating models, vendor landscapes, and emerging technologies to drive continuous improvement and business value.

* Lead cross\-functional product teams, delivery partners, and vendors to deliver strategic outcomes and operational improvements.
* Ensure successful execution of major global programmes, releases, and transformation initiatives.

 Stakeholder Management

* Present roadmaps, investment proposals, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive stakeholders.
* Influence decision making across functional and technical teams while balancing short\-term operational needs with long\-term strategic goals.


**Essential**
 Required Experience
   

  

* 15\+ years of experience in HR Technology, Payroll Technology, or Enterprise Product Management.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Workday Payroll and/or Workday Time \& Attendance.
* Experience managing complex global Payroll and Time technology landscapes.
* Proven success delivering large\-scale HR or Payroll transformation programmes.
* Experience leading product roadmaps, prioritization, and agile delivery teams.
* Deep understanding of payroll integrations, upstream/downstream system dependencies, and payroll data flows.
* Experience managing AMS providers, managed services, and outsourced support models.
* Strong understanding of governance, risk, compliance, controls, and audit requirements within payroll environments.
* Demonstrated experience driving automation, simplification, and process transformation initiatives.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Workday Extend, Integration Cloud, Prism, or related technologies.
* Experience operating in global, highly regulated environments.
* Exposure to AI, intelligent automation, workflow orchestration, and employee service technologies.
* Knowledge of Workforce Management, scheduling, absence, and time capture solutions.


**Key Competencies**
* Strategic Product Leadership
* Payroll Domain Expertise
* Enterprise Transformation Delivery
* Vendor \& Managed Service Management
* Technology \& Integration Architecture Awareness
* Commercial \& Financial Acumen
* Data\-Driven Decision Making
* Influencing \& Executive Stakeholder Management
* Change Leadership
* Continuous Improvement Mindset


**Success Measures**
* Stable, compliant, and efficient payroll operations globally.
* Reduction in manual interventions and payroll defects.
* Increased automation and input consolidation across payroll processes.
* Successful delivery of strategic payroll transformation initiatives.
* Improved vendor performance and service quality.

title: Technical Product Owner - Sales Technology & AI
description:
**Position Type**
 Full time
   

  

**Type Of Hire**
 Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
   

  

**Technical Product Manager – Commercial Sales Technology \& AI**
 At FIS, our technology and our people are moving forward. We advance the way the world pays, banks and invests. We believe in building inclusive, diverse teams. Together, we innovate to help our colleagues, clients and communities succeed. If you're ready to grow your career and make an impact in fintech, we have one question\~ Are you FIS?
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you ready to own the sales technology and AI infrastructure that powers a global commercial organization — keeping it live, trusted, and embedded in the way sellers actually work?
   

  

 FIS is looking for a Technical Product Manager to join the Sales Technology \& AI team within Revenue Operations, Commercial Office. This is the role that takes ownership of a defined portfolio of seller\-facing platforms and AI\-enabled workflows — not just configuring them, but governing, documenting, and driving adoption across a large, distributed commercial organization.
   

  

 This is an individual contributor role with genuine hands\-on ownership. You will not manage a team — you will own the operational detail that keeps critical systems running and adopted. You will administer platforms, configure AI agents, maintain renewal intelligence dashboards, and serve as the go\-to expert for the commercial technology stack. The ideal candidate brings the technical fluency to own platform administration end\-to\-end, the communication skills to translate complexity into clear guidance for sellers, and the delivery instinct to follow through until the job is done — not just planned.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
**Platform Ownership and Administration**
* Own the day\-to\-day administration of the commercial sales technology platforms — Seismic (content enablement), Responsive and LinkedIn (seller intelligence) — keeping them configured, governed and available for the field
* Own super\-admin and administrator access, SSO configuration, user roles and access controls — taking hands\-on responsibility for the technical set\-up and the business decisions around access, including clean transition and handover of these responsibilities
* Manage vendor and support interactions across the platform portfolio to keep systems running, resolve issues, and land upgrades and configuration changes on schedule
* Maintain clear documentation of configuration, access, ownership and support paths so the platforms are auditable, supportable, and never dependent on one person's memory


**AI Agents and MCP Enablement**
* Own the business\-side setup, documentation and adoption of commercial AI agents and copilots — including the CIQ Training Agent, Sales Assistant Agent, FIS Procurement Assistant and Win/Loss Intelligence Advisor — configuring, testing, rolling out and supporting them for everyday seller use
* Own the business context and operating model for MCP server integration with Seismic and Responsive — defining, in clear business terms, how AI experiences connect to approved commercial systems and data
* Support in\-flight pilots such as Othello.ai through use\-case articulation, rollout planning, adoption tracking and success measurement
* Work with technical and security stakeholders to ensure integrations are set up correctly, and translate what they mean for users, support and ongoing ownership
* Sense\-check new AI use cases for value, risk and adoption readiness before rollout — so what ships is practical and actually used, not just technically possible


**Renewal and Retention Intelligence**
* Own and maintain the Global Client Retention renewal intelligence dashboards as a reliable, business\-facing reporting capability that commercial teams can trust and act on
* Keep the data usable and accurate — diagnose and fix issues as they arise, and improve dashboards based on how commercial teams actually use them in practice
* Translate dashboard output into clear, regular updates that drive commercial action rather than passive reporting


**Enablement, Technical Content and Adoption**
* Produce clear technical content and documentation — configuration guides, playbooks, one\-page summaries, process maps and user how\-to material that sellers can pick up and use without hand\-holding
* Lead practical rollout and adoption activity\~ communications, training materials, readiness checklists and feedback loops for platform launches, AI agent releases and dashboard changes
* Support global users by diagnosing friction points, simplifying workflows and answering the day\-to\-day questions that keep adoption high across NA, EMEA and APAC
* Maintain a clear view of what is owned here versus what sits with enterprise IT, and know when to escalate — and how


**What You Will Need**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience administering enterprise sales technology or commercial platforms — owning configuration, access management and day\-to\-day operation, not just advising on it
* Hands\-on experience configuring SSO, super\-admin / administrator access, user roles and access controls — comfortable owning both the technical setup and the business decisions around access, including ownership transition
* Demonstrated ability to write clear technical content and documentation — configuration guides, playbooks and user\-facing how\-to material that real users adopt
* Sufficient business understanding of integrations and MCP servers to own the business side, brief technical teams, and explain what they mean for users and support without jargon
* Practical, hands\-on experience working with AI tools or agents in a business setting — configuring, rolling out and supporting them for real users, not just evaluating them
* A strong bias for execution and delivery — someone who owns the operational detail, follows through, and keeps systems running reliably. This is a role for a doer who enjoys ownership and getting things done well
* Comfort working independently in a global organization and moving work forward through influence rather than formal authority


**What You Should Have**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field
* Background in fintech, financial services, enterprise SaaS, revenue operations or commercial technology
* Experience with sales content, RFP / response management, seller\-workflow platforms, commercial data tools or AI\-enabled productivity tools
* Working knowledge of platform administration, access models, vendor management and basic security\-review processes
* Experience creating adoption materials such as playbooks, one\-page guides, process maps and training material that field teams actually use
* A practical view of how AI, automation and integrations reduce workflow friction when embedded in real work and kept simple — and where they don't


**What We Offer You**
* Opportunities to innovate in fintech
* Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere
* Professional and personal development
* Resources to contribute to your community
* Competitive salary and benefits


**Privacy Statement**
 FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.
   

  

**Sourcing Model**
 Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: Data Products and Solution Strategy Expert
description:
**About Astellas**
 Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com.
   

  

 Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?
   

  

 We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.
   

  

**Purpose And Scope**
 Astellas is seeking a strategic, results\-driven data solutions expert to drive the enterprise adoption of modern data principles – including data mesh, domain\-driven architecture, and data products—on the Databricks cloud platform. This role ensures alignment of data initiatives with business priorities, fosters cross\-functional collaboration, and delivers measurable business value through advanced data capabilities.
   

  

 The Data Products \& Solution Strategy (DPSS) Expert is a senior individual‑contributor and solution‑delivery role within the Data Products \& Solution Strategy Chapter. This is a global, cross\-functional role responsible for the hands‑on design, delivery, and adoption of data products, analytics, and AI‑enabled solutions, primarily supporting VALUE Delivery across Commercial and Medical Affairs.
   

  

 Reporting to the Chapter Lead, Data Products \& Solution Strategy, the DPSS Expert focuses on execution excellence, translating defined data product strategies and priorities into production‑ready, business‑consumable solutions hosted on Databricks via the business\-facing internal Data Marketplace platform. The role operates at the intersection of advanced data technologies and business needs, ensuring solutions are technically robust, reusable, discoverable, and aligned to business workflows across VALUE Delivery while also effectively collaborating with other VALUE verticals (VALUE Creation/R\&D and VALUE Enablement functional areas such as DigitalExcellence/IT, Procurement, Finance, etc.)
   

  

 The role is predominantly business delivery‑oriented combined with technical acumen in advanced data offerings, with meaningful engagement with business and analytics stakeholders to support adoption and impact.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Accountabilities**
 VALUE Delivery Enablement and Chapter Strategy
   

  

 Support the scope and operational activities of the Data Products \& Solution Strategy Chapter within the Data Strategy Practice, translating chapter priorities into actionable initiatives.
   

  

 Partner closely with the Chapter Lead, Data Products \& Solution Strategy to Execute the chapter roadmap, scope, and operating model.
   

  

 Represent the chapter in cross‑functional forums and initiatives as delegated.
   

  

 Serve as a trusted partner to business, analytics, domain/data products stakeholders, global/regional and brand teams across VALUE Delivery.
   

  

 Support demand intake and prioritization for VALUE Delivery–focused data initiatives, balancing business value with platform capacity and architectural integrity.
   

  

 Ensure outputs are actionable, interpretable, and aligned to how business teams work.
   

  

 Support enablement activities including demos, walkthroughs, and documentation.
   

  

**Data Products \& Solutions Delivery**
 Deliver sound business and functional requirements to support the design, build, and implementation of data products and analytical solutions aligned to Commercial and Medical Affairs use cases.
   

  

 To ensure business roadmap is consistently carried out, influence across the implementation and evolution of:
   

  

 Databricks Lakehouse, including Delta, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Workflows, and Databricks One
   

  

 Modern data lake and lakehouse architecture
   

  

 Advanced analytics, feature engineering, and semantic modeling
   

  

 AI/ML and Generative AI–enabled analytics and applications
   

  

 Ensure solutions are production‑ready, performant, secure, and scalable, while fitting within established platform and architecture standards.
   

  

 Apply defined data product standards, patterns, and lifecycle practices.
   

  

 Assist in troubleshooting and resolving business and technical issues across data pipelines, analytics layers, and AI solutions.
   

  

 Data Marketplace \& Platform Enablement
   

  

 Actively support the adoption and effective use of the Internal Data Marketplace by analytics teams and business users.
   

  

 Support publishing and maintenance of data products/assets within the Internal Data Marketplace, ensuring proper documentation, metadata, and usability.
   

  

 Partner with platform, data engineering, and Digital Excellence teams to:
   

  

 Implement reusable components and accelerators
   

  

 Align with tooling, integration, and security requirements
   

  

 Improve performance and reliability of data assets
   

  

 Participate in continuous improvement of data marketplace capabilities and user experience.
   

  

 Execution, Governance, and Agile Ways of Working
   

  

 As an active member of the Data Products \& Mesh Value Team within Customer Engagement Solutions Hub, engage in the quarterly planning cycles (QPC) and demand management for data products/solutions and Marketplace initiatives.
   

  

 Execute data product and analytics work using Agile delivery practices, contributing to sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery execution.
   

  

 Actively use tools such as Azure DevOps (ADO) to manage work items and dependencies.
   

  

 Adhere to data governance expectations, including Data quality and validation, Lineage and documentation, and Access and security controls.
   

  

 Contribute to tracking delivery metrics such as usage, performance, and solution reliability.
   

  

 Contribute to and enforce data product lifecycle standards, including documentation, quality SLAs, and usage metrics.
   

  

 Collaboration and Stakeholder Management
   

  

 Work closely with VALUE Delivery stakeholders, DX/IT, other functional areas (e.g. Finance, Legal, Procurement, etc.), and external partners.
   

  

 Communicate technical topics clearly to non‑technical audiences when required.
   

  

 Translate business questions, requirements, and strategic priorities into well\-defined, technically executable data product and solution designs.
   

  

 Provide clear status updates and surface risks or dependencies early.
   

  

 Foster strong collaboration between business stakeholders, DX, and external partners to ensure alignment, transparency, and shared accountability.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
**Job Competencies and Knowledge:**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline.
   

  

 6–10\+ years of experience in advanced data engineering, analytics, or data platform roles.
   

  

 Hands‑on experience with Databricks and modern cloud data platforms.
   

  

**Solid Expertise In**
 Modern data lake / lakehouse architectures
   

  

 Data modeling and analytics development
   

  

 Advanced analytics and AI/ML concepts, including Generative AI
   

  

 Strong communication skills with the ability to influence without authority.
   

  

 Experience working in cross‑functional, matrixed teams.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience supporting Commercial or Medical Affairs analytics, preferably in life sciences or regulated industries.
   

  

 Familiarity with data mesh, data product, and marketplace concepts.
   

  

 Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
   

  

 Databricks or cloud platform certifications.
   

  

 Experience with BI and analytics tools such as Qlik, Tableau, or similar.
   

  

**Working Environment**
 At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility.
   

  

**What awaits you at Astellas?**
 Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like\-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
   

  

 Real\-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
   

  

 Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
   

  

 A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.
   

  

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**
 Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.
   

  

 Behaviors: We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

title: BUSINESS HEAD – BESS
description:
**BUSINESS HEAD – BESS** 




**CXO \| Business Leadership \| Product \& Technology \| Full P\&L Ownership** 




**Location:** 
 India
 *(Location will be communicated to the selected candidate)* 




**Experience:** 
 20\+ Years
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Board of Directors
 



**Leadership Level:** 
 CXO
 



  





**EXECUTIVE MANDATE** 




 We are seeking a
 **high\-calibre BESS industry leader** 
 to take complete ownership of the organisation's
 **Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) business** 
 and lead it into its next phase of scale, technology leadership and profitable growth.
 



  





 This is a
 **strategic CXO mandate for a proven BESS business leader** 
 , not a conventional General Management, Sales or Operations leadership position.
 



 The incumbent will own the
 **complete BESS product business and its P\&L** 
 , with strategic and operational leadership across:
 



  





 The successful candidate will be expected to bring
 **deep, hands\-on industry expertise in BESS / Battery Energy Storage Systems** 
 , together with a demonstrated track record of building, scaling and commercially leading a product\-centric energy\-storage business.
 



 The role requires an individual who understands the BESS ecosystem at both
 **strategic and technical\-commercial levels** 
 and can translate technology, market dynamics and customer requirements into a scalable and profitable business.
 



 The incumbent will operate with significant autonomy and will be a
 **key member of the senior leadership team with direct access to and accountability before the Board of Directors.** 




  





**MANDATE OF THE ROLE** 




 The Business Head – BESS will be accountable for creating a
 **market\-leading, technology\-competitive and financially sustainable BESS business** 
 .
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. BESS BUSINESS \& P\&L LEADERSHIP** 



* Own the
 **end\-to\-end P\&L of the BESS business** 
 .
* Define and execute the BESS business strategy across short\-, medium\- and long\-term horizons.
* Establish revenue, EBITDA, margin, cash\-flow and capital\-efficiency objectives.
* Drive business growth through disciplined portfolio, pricing, customer and channel strategies.
* Develop annual operating plans, business budgets and strategic investment priorities.
* Establish a rigorous business\-performance management framework.
* Identify structural opportunities to improve margins, cost position and capital efficiency.
* Make strategic decisions on product portfolio, capacity, investments, partnerships and market expansion.
* Present business strategy, financial performance, market outlook and strategic recommendations directly to the Board.



  





**2\. BESS MARKET \& COMMERCIAL LEADERSHIP** 



* Own the
 **BESS go\-to\-market strategy** 
 and overall commercial architecture.
* Develop and execute market\-entry and market\-expansion strategies across relevant BESS applications.
* Build relationships with strategic customers, utilities, renewable\-energy players, IPPs, C\&I customers, EPC ecosystem partners and other key BESS stakeholders.
* Lead strategic customer acquisition and high\-value commercial engagements.
* Build a high\-quality order pipeline aligned with profitability and capacity strategy.
* Establish appropriate pricing, product positioning and commercial models.
* Drive strategic account development and long\-term customer relationships.
* Identify emerging BESS applications and convert market opportunities into scalable product propositions.
* Establish the organisation as a credible and differentiated BESS technology and product partner.



  





**3\. PRODUCT STRATEGY \& PORTFOLIO OWNERSHIP** 



* Own the
 **BESS product portfolio and product roadmap** 
 .
* Translate customer, market and technology requirements into commercially viable product strategies.
* Determine product architecture, configurations, specifications and positioning in collaboration with Engineering and Technology teams.
* Lead product lifecycle management from
 **concept → development → validation → industrialisation → commercialisation → continuous improvement** 
 .
* Drive product competitiveness across:
* System cost
* Energy density
* Efficiency
* Reliability
* Safety
* Lifecycle
* Performance
* Scalability
* Maintainability
* Develop differentiated product platforms for targeted market segments.
* Establish a strong
 **design\-to\-cost and value\-engineering philosophy** 
 .
* Continuously evaluate emerging BESS technologies and their commercial implications.



  





**4\. TECHNOLOGY \& ENGINEERING LEADERSHIP** 




 The incumbent must possess sufficient technical depth to engage with senior engineering and technology teams on the strategic direction of the BESS platform.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Lead the overall BESS technology and engineering strategy.
* Drive system architecture and product engineering direction.
* Guide development across relevant BESS subsystems and technologies including:
* Battery systems
* Battery Management Systems (BMS)
* Power Conversion Systems (PCS)
* Energy Management Systems (EMS)
* Thermal management
* Fire and safety systems
* Controls and communication systems
* System integration
* Evaluate technology roadmaps and technology risks.
* Develop strategic relationships with technology providers and component OEMs.
* Drive localisation and technology capability development.
* Ensure product engineering is aligned with
 **cost, manufacturability, reliability and customer requirements** 
 .
* Establish a culture of technology innovation and continuous product improvement.



  





**5\. MANUFACTURING \& INDUSTRIALISATION** 



* Own the strategic manufacturing agenda for the BESS product business.
* Drive industrialisation of new BESS products from engineering through commercial production.
* Develop manufacturing capacity in line with the business and product roadmap.
* Drive manufacturing scalability, productivity and cost competitiveness.
* Establish strong Design\-for\-Manufacturing and Design\-for\-Assembly principles.
* Improve manufacturing yields, throughput, quality and asset utilisation.
* Drive manufacturing automation and process improvement wherever commercially justified.
* Ensure manufacturing capability can support rapid business scale\-up without compromising quality or delivery performance.
* Establish operational excellence standards across BESS manufacturing.



  





**6\. SUPPLY CHAIN \& STRATEGIC SOURCING** 



* Own the strategic direction of the BESS supply\-chain ecosystem.
* Build a resilient supply chain for critical cells, modules, PCS, BMS, EMS, thermal systems, enclosures and other key components.
* Develop strategic supplier partnerships and long\-term sourcing arrangements.
* Drive supplier qualification, localisation and alternate\-source development.
* Build a competitive cost structure through strategic sourcing and value engineering.
* Manage supply\-chain risks arising from technology changes, commodity movements, geopolitical dependencies and capacity constraints.
* Optimise inventory, procurement cycles and working capital.
* Align supply\-chain strategy with product roadmap and business growth.



  





**7\. SERVICES \& PRODUCT LIFECYCLE** 



* Own the strategic direction of BESS product lifecycle services.
* Develop a differentiated after\-sales and service proposition.
* Establish warranty, technical\-support, preventive\-maintenance and remote\-monitoring capabilities as applicable.
* Build service infrastructure aligned with the installed product base.
* Develop opportunities for recurring service and lifecycle revenue.
* Use customer and field\-performance data to drive product improvement.
* Establish customer experience as a key competitive differentiator.



  





**8\. STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIPS \& ECOSYSTEM** 



* Identify and establish strategic relationships across the BESS ecosystem.
* Develop partnerships with global and domestic:
* Battery technology companies
* Cell / module manufacturers
* PCS / inverter technology providers
* BMS / EMS technology companies
* Component OEMs
* Technology licensors
* Strategic customers
* Evaluate technology partnerships, strategic alliances, JVs and other inorganic opportunities.
* Build an ecosystem that provides competitive advantage in technology, cost, supply security and market access.



  





**9\. BUSINESS TRANSFORMATION \& SCALE** 



* Build the BESS business for significant scale rather than incremental growth.
* Develop the organisation's capabilities in line with anticipated business growth.
* Identify structural improvements required across product, technology, manufacturing, commercial and supply\-chain functions.
* Establish scalable systems, governance and performance mechanisms.
* Drive continuous improvement in
 **cost, quality, speed, innovation and customer experience** 
 .
* Build a business model capable of competing with established domestic and global BESS players.



  





**10\. ORGANISATION \& LEADERSHIP** 



* Build a world\-class BESS leadership team across:
* Sales \& Business Development
* Product Management
* Engineering
* Technology
* Manufacturing
* Supply Chain
* Quality
* Services
* Commercial / Business Operations
* Recruit senior industry talent with deep BESS expertise.
* Build succession capability for critical leadership positions.
* Establish clear accountability and performance ownership.
* Create a culture of
 **innovation, speed, customer orientation, commercial discipline and execution excellence** 
 .



  





**11\. BOARD \& STAKEHOLDER LEADERSHIP** 




  





**NON\-NEGOTIABLE CANDIDATE PROFILE** 




**Industry Background** 




**The candidate must come from the BESS / Battery Energy Storage Systems industry.** 




  





 The preferred background would include leadership experience with:
 


* BESS manufacturers
* Battery Energy Storage System integrators
* Energy\-storage product companies
* Battery technology / system companies
* BESS technology companies
* Large\-scale energy\-storage solution providers



  





**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE** 




**Minimum 20\+ Years of Professional Experience** 




 With substantial experience in
 **BESS / Battery Energy Storage Systems** 
 , including senior leadership responsibility for a product\-oriented business.
 



  





**Mandatory Leadership Experience** 




 The candidate must have previously operated at a senior leadership level such as:
 



**Business Head / President / CEO / Business CEO / COO / CXO / SVP / EVP / Senior Vice President / equivalent BESS business leadership role** 




 with meaningful ownership of business outcomes.
 



  





**EDUCATION** 



* Bachelor's / Master's degree in
 **Engineering / Technology** 
 is preferred.
* MBA / PGDM from a reputed institution will be an advantage.
* Strong preference for candidates with an educational foundation in
 **Electrical, Electronics, Energy, Power, Mechanical, Chemical or related engineering disciplines** 
 .

title: Strategic Programs Associate Manager
description:

**Management Level:** 
 CL7 \- Manager
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru / Open
   

  

**Role Context**
 The Office of the COO is responsible for orchestrating corporate operations across all Accenture organizations and bringing the firm’s strategies to life. Within this scope, the Enterprise Operations and Profitability Management team plays a pivotal role in advancing Accenture’s profit ambitions, with a sharp focus on unlocking structural efficiencies and driving sustainable enterprise\-wide profitability.
   

  

 The team is structured into three strategic towers: Activation, Realization, and Modernization. This role sits within the Modernization Tower, which is responsible for reimagining operating models, accelerating enterprise innovation, and shaping next\-generation executive capabilities.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will lead strategic product and AI initiatives end\-to\-end, working closely with CIO / Global IT, Finance, and senior business leadership. You will be accountable not only for designing and scaling AI\-powered products, but also for driving measurable enterprise impact, adoption, and value realization.
   

  

 This is a fast\-paced, highly ambiguous environment requiring structured problem solving, strong product leadership, and the ability to guide teams through undefined problem spaces.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 As a Manager, you will serve as a Product Lead for Agentic AI and data\-driven platforms that support executive decision\-making and profitability outcomes.
   

  

 You will own the full product lifecycle at a portfolio level, including strategy, prioritization, delivery oversight, and adoption at scale. In addition, you will lead cross\-functional teams, shape AI product strategy, and ensure alignment with enterprise priorities.
   

  

 The role requires a balance of:
   

  

* Strategic product thinking
* Hands\-on understanding of Agentic AI systems
* Leadership of teams and stakeholders
* Accountability for business outcomes and value realization.


- 

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy \& Leadership**
* Define and drive product strategy and multi\-quarter roadmap for Agentic AI and enterprise data products aligned to profitability and operational goals
* Own end\-to\-end accountability for product outcomes, including adoption, business impact, and scalability
* Lead product portfolio prioritization, balancing strategic initiatives, technical feasibility, and enterprise value
* Guide and mentor junior product managers / analysts, ensuring high\-quality execution and delivery


**Agentic AI \& Intelligent Systems**
* Lead the design and scaling of Agentic AI solutions for complex enterprise decision support use cases
* Establish best practices for prompt engineering, agent orchestration, and response governance
* Oversee validation frameworks to ensure accuracy, explainability, and executive trust in AI outputs
* Partner with CIO / engineering teams to industrialize AI solutions, ensuring robustness, security, and scalability


**Enterprise Data \& Product Design**
* Drive integration of enterprise data ecosystems (Finance, HR, Sales, Delivery) into product and AI solutions
* Define data architecture requirements, governance models, and guardrails for AI\-driven decision systems
* Ensure products deliver intuitive, explainable, and insight\-driven experiences for senior leaders
* Translate complex data into actionable intelligence tied to business levers


**Profitability \& Value Realization**
* Lead initiatives that embed profit discipline into leadership decision\-making through AI and data products
* Own quantification of value realization, linking product outputs to financial metrics and performance improvement
* Identify and scale opportunities that drive structural efficiency and margin expansion
* Ensure all products are explicitly tied to enterprise KPIs and measurable outcomes


**Stakeholder Leadership \& CIO Collaboration**
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing decisions on product direction, trade\-offs, and investments
* Lead collaboration with CIO / Global IT on architecture, data access, security, and deployment strategies
* Drive alignment across business, finance, and technology stakeholders to ensure successful execution
* Communicate strategic vision, progress, and impact clearly at leadership forums


**Must\-Have Skills \& Experience**
* Strong product management experience with ownership of complex, enterprise\-scale products or platforms
* Proven experience in leading cross\-functional teams and delivering end\-to\-end solutions
* Hands\-on experience with Generative AI / Agentic AI, including prompt engineering and AI system design
* Deep ability to work with enterprise data and translate it into product and AI capabilities
* Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity and lead problem structuring and solutioning
* Experience partnering with CIO / engineering organizations to scale production\-grade solutions
* Strong executive presence, communication, and stakeholder influence skills
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Power BI


- 

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Experience building and scaling AI agents, copilots, or enterprise AI platforms
* Familiarity with enterprise systems (Finance, HR, ERP, reporting platforms)
* Exposure to profitability management, financial modeling, or enterprise performance frameworks
* Experience managing global or distributed teams


- 

- 

**Why Join the Modernization Tower**
* Lead high\-impact initiatives at the intersection of product, data, and Agentic AI
* Own and scale capabilities used by senior Accenture leadership globally
* Drive enterprise\-level transformation and measurable profitability outcomes
* Work directly with C\-suite stakeholders and CIO leadership on critical priorities
* Operate in a role that combines strategy, execution, and innovation at scale

 Strategic offering/product planning expertise, including market and competitive analysis, data\-driven business cases, and value proposition development to shape vision and roadmap.

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 Geo Makers extends Geo’s mission by empowering millions of businesses and developers with real world platforms and solutions that help people explore, navigate and get things done in the real world. We do this by exposing various APIs collectively called Google Maps Platform (GMP). The customers use us in both Business\-to\-Consumer (B2C) (e.g. schedule a ride, locate a store or find your next vacation) and Business\-to\-Business (B2B) (manage a fleet of trucks, or assess insurance risk) contexts.
   

  

 The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.
   

  

 The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

* Define and evolve the product vision for BrewDat's data engineering layer (ingestion, transformation, and serving).
* Translate company and data strategy into a clear, prioritized roadmap for your squad.
* Discovery \& User\-Centricity
* Deeply understand the needs of data engineers, analytics engineers, domain squads, and internal platform users.
* Run product discovery: interviews, usage analysis, experiments, and feedback loops with internal customers.
* Roadmap \& Delivery
* Own and manage the product backlog for the Data Engineering squad.
* Write clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, focusing on outcomes rather than outputs.
* Work in an Agile environment, participating in ceremonies and ensuring alignment between Product, Engineering, and Architecture.
* Measurement \& Continuous Improvement
* Define and track product KPIs: adoption, CSAT from users, build times, time\-to\-data, platform reliability, etc.
* Use data and feedback to continuously refine priorities and validate if shipped features are creating value.
* Promote a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement within the squad.
* Stakeholder Management \& Communication
* Align with multiple stakeholders (domains like sales, marketing, supply, finance, tech, etc.).
* Communicate roadmap, progress, trade\-offs, and impact clearly and frequently.
* Partner with the Adoption team to launch new capabilities, manage change, and scale usage.
* Middleware
* Managing the consolidated middleware roadmap, prioritizing global reliability frameworks (like cross\-zone replication/caching), and tracking integration unit economics (e.g., standardizing integration cost per application).


**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS** 
**:**
**Must\-Have**
* Solid experience as a Product Manager (or Product Owner acting as PM) in:
* Data platforms, data engineering, analytics platforms, or developer/platform tools, or
* Technical products with strong infrastructure or backend components.
* Technical background (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Data, or equivalent experience). You don't need to code daily, but you must:
* Be comfortable discussing architecture, pipelines, and technical trade\-offs with engineers.
* Understand concepts like data pipelines, ETL/ELT, orchestration, data lakes, data warehouses, and APIs.
* Broaden the technical scope to include API management, event\-driven architectures, and microservices alongside the existing data pipeline concepts.


**Strong skills in:**
* Product discovery and problem framing.
* Prioritization and roadmap management.
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, negotiate priorities, and align diverse interests.
* Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken).


**Nice\-to\-Have (Differentials)**
* Experience with some of the technologies and concepts we use is a big plus, but not mandatory:
* Cloud \& Data: Azure, Databricks, Apache Spark, Airflow, Unity Catalog.
* Engineering Practices: GitHub, CI/CD, code review flows, Data Mesh.
* Experience with internal platforms or "products for developers/data teams" is especially valuable.

*And above all of this, an undying love for beer!*
*We dream big to create future with more cheers*

title: Product Analyst
description:
**About Olyv**

In addition to lending solutions, Olyv offers digital gold savings, credit health products, and other financial wellness solutions.

You live in the field, find the real problem, and own it until it is solved and measured, working with engineering, design, data, sales, and support to get there.
 


 What you'll do
 * Own products end to end: Shape a rough idea into a sharp PRD, prioritize hard, ship it, and measure the outcome. Always separate the real need from what people ask for.
* Live in the field: Sit with fleet owners, drivers, and operators where they work, run a customer advisory board, and find the real problem, not the surface one.
* Grow into new markets: Take the product into new customer categories and new geographies, and go get the operators no one serves well today.
* Aim for the multiple: Study the competition, know where we are ahead and behind, and push every feature to be 5x\-10x better, not a little better.
* Set the metric and the guardrail: Give every feature a success metric that proves the promise, and a guardrail for what breaks if it works too well.
* Work AI\-first: Use AI across the whole job (discovery, research, prototyping, PRDs, analysis) to move fast and go deep. Push it hard.


 What we're looking for
 * 3\+ years in product management, ideally B2B software, fleet, logistics, IoT, telematics, automotive, or operations\-heavy products.
* You have owned a product end to end and moved a real metric, from discovery through launch to adoption and revenue.
* You are excellent at discovery: you find the real problem, tell a need from a want and a root cause from a symptom, and move on the best truth available instead of waiting for perfect data.
* High ownership: You do whatever it takes to reach the outcome, vendor and supplier coordination included, and "that's not my job" is not in your vocabulary.
* AI\-first: You already use AI tools every day and push them hard. You don't shy away from learning new methods and tools to leverage AI better.
* A people person who gets the unsaid truth out of a fleet owner, and willing to travel and sit in hard places. If a problem lives in a mine, that is where you will be.


 Why Bytebeam
 * Real products, used in production by teams running connected vehicles and fleets.
* High ownership in a small team: fewer layers, faster decisions, and close contact with customers. You own your product and run it.
* Work that spans software, hardware, field operations, fleet economics, and reliability.

We’re much more than a digital resume – we transform lives through innovative products and technology. At LinkedIn, we strive to help our employees find passion and purpose. description:
**Who We Are**
 Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services. With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better’, Revantage delivers value\-added services and world\-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. Headquartered in Chicago, the company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.
   

  

 Rooted in a commitment to collaboration and inclusivity, Revantage goes beyond traditional corporate services and acts as a trusted partner. Across offerings that include finance, technology, human resources and operations, Revantage proactively anticipates stakeholder needs, recruits exceptional talent and enables its business partners to thrive.
   

  

 Technical Product Manager
   

  

 Want to be a part of Asia Pacific \& Japan’s (APJ) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?
   

  

 AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose \- to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers \- the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.
   

  

 Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APJ region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…
   

  

 Come join the A\-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.
   

  

 A Snapshot
   

  

 We are seeking a hands\-on, technically strong product manager to help shape and deliver high\-impact digital products at AirTrunk.
   

  

 In this role, you will own the discovery, design, delivery, adoption and continuous improvement of technology\-enabled products that help our teams work faster, smarter and with greater operational discipline. Depending on business priorities, these products may include internal SaaS\-style applications, workflow platforms, data\-enabled products, decision support tools, integrations, automation solutions and AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 You will work closely with business teams, engineering, data, AI and technology stakeholders to turn complex operational needs into clear product strategies, pragmatic roadmaps and scalable solutions. You will be comfortable operating across the full product lifecycle, from identifying the right problem to solve, through to shaping user journeys, defining requirements, partnering with engineering, managing delivery, measuring value and iterating based on feedback.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for someone who combines strong product management discipline with technical depth. You do not need to be an AI product specialist, but you should be fluent in how modern product teams can use AI to improve discovery, delivery, analysis, prototyping, documentation and decision\-making. You should also be able to identify practical opportunities to embed AI, automation and data\-driven capabilities where they genuinely improve product outcomes.
   

  

 Your Day to Day
   

  

 Product Ownership \& Delivery
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of digital products and technology\-enabled capabilities, from discovery and problem definition through to delivery, adoption, measurement and iteration.
   

  

 Develop clear product visions, roadmaps, value cases and success metrics aligned to business priorities.
   

  

 Page \| 2
   

  

 Translate complex business needs into well\-structured product requirements, user stories, process flows, data needs and technical considerations.
   

  

 Make clear prioritisation decisions based on user value, business impact, feasibility, risk and delivery capacity.
   

  

 Bring structure and product discipline to ambiguous opportunities, helping teams move from ideas and requests to clearly defined problems, outcomes and delivery options.
   

  

 Technical Product Delivery
   

  

 Partner with engineering, data, AI, architecture and technology teams to design and deliver scalable products, platforms and technology\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 Work across user experience, workflow design, data models, APIs, integrations, reporting, security, governance and operational support requirements.
   

  

 Help shape SaaS\-style and platform\-based solutions that are reliable, usable, maintainable and designed for enterprise adoption.
   

  

 Collaborate with technology teams to define MVPs, delivery increments and long\-term product evolution.
   

  

 Ensure products are designed with appropriate attention to usability, performance, resilience, data quality, security and supportability.
   

  

 Balance speed, quality and scalability by making pragmatic trade\-offs between immediate business value and longer\-term product sustainability.
   

  

 AI, Automation \& Modern Product Practice
   

  

 Use AI and automation tools to improve the way product work is done, including discovery synthesis, research analysis, prototyping, documentation, backlog creation, testing support and stakeholder communication.
   

  

 Identify practical opportunities to embed AI, automation or data\-driven decisioning into products and workflows where they create measurable value.
   

  

 Promote responsible, secure and pragmatic use of AI within product delivery and product experiences.
   

  

 Model modern ways of working by using AI thoughtfully to improve quality, speed, clarity and decision\-making across current initiatives.
   

  

 Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

 Partner with business domain experts to understand operating models, pain points, workflows, decisions and user needs.
   

  

 Communicate product vision, trade\-offs, delivery progress, risks and value outcomes clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 Facilitate alignment across business, technology, data, AI, security and operations teams.
   

  

 Act as the bridge between business problems and technology solutions, ensuring delivery remains anchored to measurable outcomes.
   

  

 Influence without authority across complex stakeholder groups, bringing clarity to competing priorities and helping teams make informed product decisions.
   

  

 Product Excellence \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

 Use product analytics, telemetry, user feedback and operational data to evaluate product performance and identify improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Page \| 3
   

  

 Drive adoption and change management in partnership with business teams, ensuring products are embedded into real ways of working.
   

  

 Continuously improve product practices, templates, rituals and standards across AirTrunk’s product community.
   

  

 Stay informed on modern product management, enterprise SaaS, digital platforms, AI\-enabled product delivery and emerging technology trends.
   

  

 Create a strong feedback loop between users, business stakeholders and delivery teams to ensure products continue to evolve based on evidence, value and changing business needs.
   

  

**Requirements**
 5\+ years' experience in product management, technical product management, digital product delivery, enterprise technology, SaaS products, platform products, data products or related roles.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience owning products or technology\-enabled capabilities through the full lifecycle, including discovery, prioritisation, delivery, adoption, measurement and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Strong product management discipline, including problem discovery, user research, roadmap development, requirements definition, backlog management, Agile delivery, release planning and value measurement.
   

  

 Strong technical fluency across modern software delivery, APIs, integrations, data platforms, workflow systems, cloud environments and enterprise architecture concepts.
   

  

 Experience working closely with engineering, data, architecture or platform teams to deliver software products, enterprise applications, internal platforms or full\-stack digital solutions.
   

  

 Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management across technical and business teams.
   

  

 Strong prioritisation and decision\-making skills, with the ability to balance user value, business impact, technical complexity, delivery capacity, risk and long\-term product sustainability.
   

  

 Comfortable using AI and modern productivity tools to improve product workflows, accelerate analysis, support documentation, improve delivery quality and model contemporary ways of working.
   

  

 Understanding of security, privacy, data governance, operational risk and responsible AI considerations in enterprise technology environments.
